Change your settings

Change Gemini’s language

Change Gemini’s language

You can choose the language Gemini Apps display, and in certain cases, understand in Language settings. This setting changes the language for the menu, notifications, and other text in Gemini Apps. It also affects the languages that you can talk to Gemini in when you say “Hey Google” or use the mic in the prompt field. Regardless of this setting, Gemini Apps can understand and reply in any supported language when you type your prompt or speak in Gemini Live.

Important: Some features in Gemini Apps, like Gemini’s voice setting, aren’t available in all languages.

Change Gemini’s language

The Gemini web app uses the language set in your browser or device language settings.

  • Change Gemini’s voice
  • Get started with the Gemini mobile app

Change Gemini’s voice

Change Gemini’s voice

You can change the voice that Gemini uses across all Gemini Apps. For now, you can only access Gemini’s voice setting in the Gemini mobile app.

Important:

  • The option to change Gemini’s voice isn’t available in some languages. Learn how to change your language.
  • To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Choose Gemini’s voice

Important: The number of voice options vary across languages.

This voice setting applies to all Gemini Apps features. It’s used in Gemini Live and features where Gemini Apps respond verbally, like when you tap Listen next to a response.

  1. Open your Gemini mobile app .
  2. At the  left, tap Menu  your Profile picture or initial Settings Gemini’s Voice.
  3. To hear a voice, tap a voice name.
  4. Tap Confirm.

  • Talk naturally with Gemini Live
  • Change Gemini’s language

Use Dark theme in Gemini Apps

Use Dark theme in Gemini Apps

You can switch between a dark theme and light theme in Gemini Apps. By default, the color scheme for the Gemini app matches the color scheme of the device you’re on.

Important:

  • In the Gemini mobile apps, you can switch between dark and light themes when you update your device’s theme settings.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Switch between dark & light themes

When you switch color schemes, your preference is saved for the next time you open the Gemini web app on the same browser and device.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. At the bottom, click Settings & help .
  3. Turn Dark theme on or off .

Create, learn & research with Gemini Apps

Create an illustrated storybook in Gemini Apps

Create an illustrated storybook in Gemini Apps

You can create a storybook from a text prompt or using your own photos in Gemini Apps. You can also have Gemini read the story aloud.

What you need

  • For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18 years old.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Create a storybook

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left under Gems, click Storybook.
    • Tip: If you don’t find Storybook, click Explore Gems  to find the complete list of Gems.
  3. In the text box, enter a prompt of the story you want to generate.
    • Optional: To upload your own photos or files for Gemini to use in your story, click Add files . Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps.
  4. Click Submit .
    • When your storybook is ready, it will open in the panel on the right.

More ways you can start a storybook

In addition to the Storybook Gem, you can start a storybook:

With a prompt in a new chat

In the text box, start your prompt with “Create a storybook about” and add your desired topic.

To start a storybook through a text prompt, “storybook” must be entered in English.

With an uploaded image
  1. In the text box at the bottom, click Add files . Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps.
  2. Select the photo(s) you want Gemini to use to create your storybook.
  3. Below the text box, click Create a storybook .

Tips:

  • It may take 1–2 minutes for the storybook to be created.
  • Storybooks generated in Gemini Apps are usually  10-12 pages.
  • To regenerate your story, in the text box on the left, tell Gemini what changes you want to make and Gemini will create a new version of the story.
  • To view your saved versions, at the top, click Previous Version  or Next Version .

Interact with a storybook

At the top of the storybook, find options for how you can interact with the book.

  • To view the storybook in full screen, click Full screen .
  • To go to the next page, click next  or the lower right corner of the book.
  • To go to the previous page, click back  or the lower left corner of the book.
  • To jump to the beginning or end, click the page number to pull up options:
    • To go to the beginning, click Jump to beginning .
    • To go to the end, click Jump to end .
  • To listen to the book, click Listen .
    • Tip: You can also change the voice reading the storybook. To change the voice, next to Listen, click  and select a different voice.

Share, print, or download a storybook

Share a public link to a storybook
  1. At the top, click Share   Share .
  2. Next to the 0 link, click Copy link . Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.

Learn more about sharing chats from Gemini Apps.

Print a storybook or save it as a PDF
  1. At the top, click Share   Print .
    • If you have pop-ups blocked, you may be asked to allow pop-ups from gemini.google.com in your browser. Steps to allow pop-ups may differ by browser. Learn how to allow pop-ups from a site in Google Chrome.
  2. Follow onscreen instructions.

Tip: You can also create a PDF of your storybook by selecting “Save as PDF” in your print options.

How to report offensive or unsafe content

If you find a storybook offensive or unsafe, you can report the content.

  1. Open the storybook.
  2. On the bottom of the cover page, click Report content.

Learn how Google uses your feedback.

Create and use an avatar in Gemini Apps

Create and use an avatar in Gemini Apps

You can record your face and voice to create your avatar to use in Gemini Apps. Once you’ve created your avatar you can use it when you create videos with Gemini Omni or images with Nano Banana and streamline your content creation process.

What you need

To create an avatar, you must:

  • Be 18 or over
  • Be signed in with a personal Google Account with an Google AI plan. Learn how to upgrade.

Important:

  • Avatars are currently not available in the EEA, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom.
  • Avatars are currently only supported in English.

Create your avatar

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com
  2. In the text box at the bottom, click Add Files  More uploads  Avatar
  3. With your phone or tablet, scan the QR code.
  4. Follow the onscreen instructions on your phone or tablet to record your face and voice.
    • You’ll need to allow access to your camera and microphone
  5. Return to your computer to finish the process.
  6. Click Use Avatar.

Tip: To try the process again you can click Retake.

Tips to record your face and voice

To make sure your recording is accepted, follow these tips:

  • Phone position: Hold your phone at eye level.
  • Lighting: Use lighting that is not too dim or too bright.
  • Visibility: Ensure your eyes, nose, and mouth are visible. Glasses are fine to keep on, but no sunglasses, masks, or hats.
  • Audio environment: Choose a quiet area to record your voice. There should be no other voices in the background.
  • Background: Check that there are no people or images of faces in your background.
  • Account owner: The account owner must complete this process. Do not allow minors to record themselves.

Use your avatar in Gemini Apps

  1. Go to gemini.google.com
  2. In the text box at the bottom, click Add files .
  3. Click Avatar .
    • Your avatar will show in your prompt as @[your Google username].
  4. Enter your prompt.
  • Click Submit .

Tip: You can also type “@” and then select your Google username from the menu to create a prompt with your avatar.

Examples
  • “Create an image of 0[your Google username]  singing with an orchestra.”
  • “Write a story where 0[your Google username]  is the main character, facing a dragon.”

Tip: To create a video with your personal avatar, you must have a Google AI plan. Learn how to upgrade.

Find and manage your avatar

Find your avatar
  1. On your phone or tablet, open the Gemini app .
  2. On the bottom left, click Settings .
  3. In the menu, click Personal avatar .

Tip: At any time you can select “Retake” to submit a new recording of your face and voice.

Delete your avatar
  1. Go to gemini.google.com
  2. On the bottom left, click Settings .
  3. In the menu, click Personal avatar .
  4. On the top right, click Delete .
    • This will take you to the Selfie video page of your Google Account
    • To preview your avatar, click Preview image.
  5. Under the selfie and voice recording you’d like to delete, click Delete .
  6. Follow the on-screen prompts.

When you delete your recordings:

  • You will not be able to create new AI-generated content with that avatar. To create new content, you will need to go back to the app or service you want to use, and create a new avatar by re-recording your selfie and voice.
  • Your recorded selfie and voice data for that avatar will be removed from Google’s systems.
  • Videos or content you already made and published with that avatar are not deleted.

Privacy and your avatar

For more info on how your data is used when you create an avatar in Gemini Apps, visit the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub.

Create docs, apps & more with Canvas

Create docs, apps & more with Canvas

You can collaborate with Gemini in Canvas to create or edit a doc, app, slides, or code. You can also turn your creation into an Audio Overview, quiz, or other format.

Important: To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Start a new chat with Canvas

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Below the text box at the bottom, click Add Files Canvas .
  3. In the text box, enter your prompt.
    • Tip: To have Gemini use a specific format or document type, like a slide deck, include this instruction in your prompt. Check examples for Canvas prompts.
  4. Optional: To upload files or an image with your prompt, click Add files .
    • Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps.
  5. Click Submit .

Examples

  • Create a slide presentation about…
  • Create a quiz to test me on…

What you can do with apps in Canvas

Edit apps & code

You can use the prompt text box to ask Gemini to make updates to your app or directly edit the code. Changes in Canvas are auto-saved.

Open the code & find errors, logs, and recent changes

  • To open and edit the code, at the top right of the Canvas panel, click Code. You can edit the code directly in the Code view.
  • To find errors and logs from the preview, at the top right of the Canvas panel, click Show console.
  • To find recent changes in the code, at the top right of the Canvas panel, click Code  Show recent changes .

Ask Gemini to help edit selections

  1. Open the chat with the app you want to edit.
  2. At the bottom right of the Canvas panel, click Select & ask .
  3. Use the cursor to select the section that you want to edit.
  4. In the text box, enter a prompt for how you want the text to be updated.
  5. Press Enter.

Add AI to your app

Important: To add AI to your app, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps and be 18 or over.

You can add Gemini-powered features to your app, like text and image generation.

  1. Open the chat with the app you want to edit.
  2. At the bottom right of the Canvas panel, click Add Gemini features .
  3. In the chat on the left, Gemini will provide an overview of what AI feature was added to the app. You can respond in the text box and ask Gemini to make additional changes.

What you can do with docs in Canvas

Edit docs in Canvas

In the Canvas space, you can directly edit the text or ask Gemini to help you in the prompt box. Changes are auto-saved.

Ask Gemini to help edit selections

  1. Open the chat you want to edit.
  2. In the Canvas panel, use the cursor to select the text that you want to edit.
  3. In the text box, enter a prompt for what you want updated.
  4. Press Enter.

Tip:  Once you select the text you want to edit, you can also click Suggest editsto have Gemini recommend changes.

Ask Gemini to make quick edits

  1. Open the chat you want to edit.
  2. In the Canvas panel on the right, choose how you want to change it:
    • To adjust the length of text: Click Change length and select your desired length.
    • To adjust the tone of text: Click Change tone  and select how casual or formal you want it to be.

Edit text style & format in a doc

  1. Open the chat you want to edit.
  2. In the Canvas panel, use the cursor to select the text that you want to edit.
  3. At the top, use the toolbar to edit your text. You can:
    • Stylize headings
    • Bold text .
    • Italicize text .
    • Create bulleted lists .
    • Create numbered lists .

Tips:

  • If you can’t find the full toolbar, click More .
  • To view your saved versions, at the top, click Previous Version  or Next Version .

Add LaTeX to a document

LaTeX is a document preparation system widely used in academic, scientific, and technical fields to create high-quality documents with complex formatting, such as mathematical equations, tables, and multi-column layouts.

  1. To add LaTeX to any doc in Canvas:
  2. Open the chat with the doc you want to edit.
  3. At the top right of the Canvas panel, click Create.
  4. To select LaTeX, click LaTeX .
  5. Click on the formula within Canvas

Exporting or sharing docs including LaTeX You can export a doc that includes LaTeX as a PDF with the ability to preview before you download it.

You can also copy any Gemini response that includes LaTeX and it will include the unrendered LaTeX code.

Create something based on a Canvas doc

Important: For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18.

  1. Open the chat with the doc you want to edit.
  2. On the top right of the Canvas panel, click Create.
  3. Select what you want to create:
    • To create a slide show, custom visual or app, in the  text box, enter a prompt that describes what you want to turn your report or doc into.
    • To generate an Audio Overview, click Audio Overview . Learn more about Audio Overviews in Gemini Apps.
    • To create and take a quiz, click Quiz .
    • To generate an infographic, click Infographic .
    • To create a web page, click Web page .

Share, copy & export from Canvas

Share an app or content from Canvas

  1. Open the chat with the doc you want to share.
  2. At the top right of the Canvas panel, click Share & export   Share .
  3. If you are sharing an app, review the app info.
  4. Choose how you want to share:
    • To share the link: At the top, next to the 0 link, click Copy link . Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.
    • To share on an available social platform: At the bottom, click the social platform and follow the on-screen instructions.
Review app info

When you create a shareable public link for your app, you’ll be able to review info about your app. Anyone with that public link can view and edit data associated with the app. You can ask Gemini to make changes and Gemini will apply updates to your app’s code.

  • Share data between users.
  • Use Gemini-powered features. For example, if you want your app to use AI to generate text and images.
  • Save data across sessions and devices. For example, if you create an app to track something over time.

Copy or export from Canvas

  1. On your computer, open the chat with the Canvas content or app you want to copy or export.
  2. At the top right of the Canvas panel, click Share & export  .
  3. Choose if you want to export or copy the content:
    • To open text in a new Google Doc: Click Export to Docs.
    • To open slides in Google Slides: Click Export to Slides. You can also choose to export slides as a PDF.
    • To copy the text: Click Copy contents .

Export Python code to Colab

  1. On your computer, open the chat with the  python code you want to export.
  2. At the top of the Canvas panel, click Export to Colab.
  3. At the bottom left, tap Open Colab.

Copy & edit shared Canvas content

Important:

  • For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18.
  • Shared links only open in gemini.google.com. You can’t open shared Canvas content in the Gemini mobile app.

When you open a public link to someone else’s shared Canvas content, you can make a copy and continue editing it with Canvas on your own. If your Keep Activity setting is on, the shared Canvas content will be stored in your Gemini Apps Activity. Learn how to manage and delete your Gemini Apps activity.

  1. Click the public link.
  2. At the bottom, click Copy Canvas.

Create quizzes, flashcards & more in Gemini Apps

Create quizzes, flashcards & more in Gemini Apps

You can use Gemini Apps to create, use, and share study materials like flashcards, quizzes, and study guides to help prepare for exams.

What you need

  • To create flashcards and study guides, you must be 18 or older.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Create quizzes, flashcards & study guides

  1. On a computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. In the text box, enter your prompt describing the type of quiz you want.
    • Tip: Start your prompt telling Gemini what to create followed by the materials or topic you want to study.
      • Quiz: “Create a quiz about”
      • Flashcards: “Create flashcards about”
      • Study guide: “Create a study guide about”
  3. Optional steps:
    • Click Add files and select the source material you want to upload as context. Learn how to upload files in Gemini Apps.
    • To generate your study guide in a doc, click Add Files Canvas .
  4. Click Submit . Your materials will open in the Canvas panel on the right.

Tip: You can also create a quiz, flashcards, or a study guide from a Canvas doc. Learn how to create study materials in Canvas.

Additional options in a quiz

After you start the quiz, you have additional options to get hints, ask questions, and practice with more questions.

  • To get a hint, click Show hint.
  • To ask Gemini additional questions about the material or topic , enter your question in the text box on the left and click Submit .
  • To move to the next question, click Next.
  • To go back to the previous question, click Previous.
  • To review your performance, after you complete the quiz, click Analyze my performance.
  • To generate more questions, when you complete the quiz, click More questions.
Use & edit flashcards

After you open your flashcards, you have additional options to get hints, shuffle cards, and listen to the questions and answers.

  • To get a hint, click Hint .
  • To shuffle the flashcards, click Shuffle mode . This will shuffle all of the flashcards in the deck.
  • To have Gemini play audio of the text, click Text to speech .
  • To flip a card to the answer or move to the next card, click Next .
  • To go through the flashcards again, when you complete the deck, click Restart flashcards.
Share a quiz, flashcard set, or study guide

Important: If you’re signed in to a work or school Google Account, you can’t share quizzes, flashcards, or study guides.

  1. On a computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Open the chat with the material you want to share.
  3. In the chat, click the quiz, flashcard set, or study guide to open it in the Canvas panel.
  4. At the top right, click Share .
  5. Choose how you want to share:
    • To share the link: At the top, next to the 0 link, click Copy link . Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.
    • To share on an available social platform: At the bottom, click the social platform and follow the on-screen instructions.

Generate & edit images with Gemini Apps

Generate & edit images with Gemini Apps

Get in the game!

For a limited time, Gemini has image templates for the ultimate soccer fan. Learn more

You can create captivating images in seconds with Nano Banana 2. From work, play, or anything in between, Gemini Apps can help you generate and refine images to help bring your imagination to life. For paid subscribers, Nano Banana Pro is also available to regenerate images.

Important: When you generate images with Gemini Apps, remember that you agreed to Google’s Terms of Service, including the Prohibited Use Policy. Be sure not to violate others’ copyright or privacy rights. Use your discretion before you rely on, publish, or use content that Gemini Apps generate. Users with a work or school account may be subject to different terms depending on the license type. Learn more about how to use Gemini Apps with your work or school Google Account.

What you need

  • This feature’s availability in any specific Gemini app is also limited to the supported languages and countries of that app.

  • To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

  • To meet the age requirements to use this feature with a personal account.

    • To generate and edit images, you must be 18 or over
    • To generate images, you must be 13 (or the applicable age in your country) or over.

  • If you are signed in to a school account, you may be subject to different access restrictions.

Key features of Nano Banana 2
  • Improved world knowledge: create diagrams and infographics with more accurate info.
  • Character consistency: Maintain the look of a person or character across various generated images, including the ability to combine multiple images to blend scenes or ideas.
  • Local edits: Making quick and specific changes to parts of an image.
  • Better text rendering: Add text to images with more accurate spelling, for all supported languages.
  • Enhanced instruction following: The model can follow more complex requests, to capture details.
  • High output quality: Preview images at high resolution. Download images at at 2K resolution with a Google AI plan or at 1K without an AI plan.

Tips:

  • Nano Banana 2 is ideal to create personalized images such as when you want to view yourself with different hairstyles, picture yourself in different scenes or create memes.

  • If you’re in the US and meet other requirements, Nano Banana 2 can also use Personal Intelligence to create and edit images tailored entirely to you. Learn how Gemini personalizes images with Personal Intelligence.

About Nano Banana models

To use a different Nano Banana model, switch your Gemini model before you create your image request.  Learn how to switch models.

Nano Banana offers different models designed for various needs.

  • Nano Banana 2 Lite: This option is used when the Gemini model is set to Flash-Lite. It  is optimized for speed. It is ideal for quick images and basic ideas. It isn’t designed for multiple image references or for multiple edits.
  • Nano Banana 2: This option is selected when you make an image request with the Gemini model set to Flash or Pro. It  balances speed with higher image quality, more world knowledge, and reliable text rendering. It can accept multiple reference images.
  • Nano Banana Pro: Available with a Google AI Plan, this option is available when you have the Gemini model set to Pro and want  to redo an image when additional detail is needed. It has the highest level of world knowledge, advanced text and language capabilities, higher consistency, and more precise creative control.

Generate & review images

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the top left, click Open Sidebar   Images .
  3. Choose a template or enter your prompt to generate an image with Nano Banana 2. Check tips for image generation prompts.
Examples
  • Generate an image of a futuristic car driving through an old mountain road surrounded by nature
  • Create an image of a dog riding a surfboard
  • Create an image of a jungle with a river in a splashy watercolor style

Create and use an avatar with Nano Banana

You can record your face and voice to create your avatar to use when you create images with Nano Banana.

Your avatar lets you create custom images or yourself without the need to upload a photo each time.

Learn how to create and use an avatar in Gemini Apps.

Edit images with Nano Banana 2

Important: Editing images isn’t available to users under 18.

With Nano Banana 2, there are a few ways that you can edit images. For example, you can:

  • Edit an image that you generated in Gemini Apps.
  • Upload an image and ask Gemini to make edits.
  • Upload multiple images and ask Gemini to create a new image based on your uploaded images.

Find examples of how you can edit images.

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the top left, click Open Sidebar   Library .
  3. Find the image you want to edit and click it.
    • Tip: You can also upload an image to edit.
  4. Under the image, click Chat
  5. In the text box at the bottom, enter your prompt.
    • Tip: You can upload an image to edit or ask Gemini to edit a generated image.
  6. Click Submit .

Redo an image with Nano Banana Pro

Paid subscribers can use Nano Banana Pro to regenerate an image. Nano Banana Pro can provide additional detail, especially for images that use text rendering or for infographics. To use Nano Banana Pro:

  1. Create an image with Nano Banana 2 or Nano Banana 2 Lite.
  2. At the bottom right, click More    Redo with Pro.

Important:  If you reach your daily quota of Nano Banana 2 images, you can’t redo any additional images with Nano Banana Pro.

Go to Connected Apps settings

Go to Connected Apps settings

Download, share, or export a generated image

Tips for image generation prompts

  • Start your prompt with words like draw, generate, and create.
  • Describe the image style you want. Here are a few examples: photorealistic, charcoal drawing, watercolor painting, cartoon illustration.
  • Include a detailed visual description of what you want in the image. This can include the subject of the image, what the subject is doing, and the background or setting.

How image generation works with Personal Intelligence

Important: Nano Banana with Personal Intelligence is only available to users 18 and over in the US. To use this feature, you must sign in to a personal Google Account. The Google Photos connected app currently isn’t available in some US regions.

You can ask Gemini to create or edit highly personalized images using Personal Intelligence. With your permission, Gemini can understand and retrieve info across your Google apps, past chats, and more to understand your unique style, life, and preferences. It then uses the latest Nano Banana model to create and edit images tailored entirely to you.

Try these example prompts:

  • Create a watercolor image of my dream house nestled in my favorite setting.
  • Create a claymation image of me and my family enjoying our favorite activity. We want to be standing in the center of the image, staring straight forward.
    • This example requires Google Photos to be connected to Gemini Apps. Learn how to connect Google Photos.

Gemini can use the labels you’ve set up in Google Photos to identify people and pets to generate images of them with Nano Banana.

Tip: To create images of other people from your Google Photos, make sure their face group is named. Learn how to set up and manage your face groups.

Personal Intelligence experiences are optional. You can choose which Google apps to connect, manage how your past chats are used, and set your own instructions. Learn how to manage Personal Intelligence in Gemini Apps.

Why Gemini Apps might remove an image

Gemini Apps may remove images for prompts when our systems detect a possible violation of Google’s Terms of Service, including the Prohibited Use Policy.

Users with a work or school account may be subject to different terms. Learn more about how to use Gemini Apps with your work or school Google Account.

Generate music with Gemini Apps

Generate music with Gemini Apps

You can create music tracks directly with Gemini Apps with Lyria, our AI music generator. If you use text and uploaded photos or videos to describe the track you have in mind, Gemini Apps will create music and lyrics. When you’re done, you can download your completed track, send it to friends, or share it on social media.

What you need

To generate music with Gemini apps you need to:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Be signed in with a personal Google Account or a supported work or school account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Have Keep Activity on.

Create music with Gemini

Important: To create a full track, switch the model to “Pro”  Learn how to switch Gemini models.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. At the bottom of the text box, tap Add Files  Create music.
  3. (Optional) Upload images or videos for added context. Learn how to upload files.

Examples
  • Create an intro track for my podcast about cats.
  • Write a short song about the Italian Renaissance.
  • Compose a lo-fi hip-hop beat with a chill, melancholic vibe and a simple piano melody.
  • Write a nostalgic song about my hometown.

Download or share your created track

Once you’ve generated a track, you can choose to save or share it:

Download your track:

Share your track:

About your created track
  • Your generated music is delivered as a video file complete with custom cover art.

Tips for music generation prompts
  • Start your prompt with words like write, compose, or create.

Music generation limits

Generate videos with Gemini Apps

Generate videos with Gemini Apps

You can create videos in minutes in Gemini Apps with Gemini Omni, our latest AI video generation model. Gemini Omni makes creating and editing videos as easy as having a conversation. Blend text, images, and video to bring your ideas to life – whether you’re creating for fun, sharing with friends, or visualizing a concept.

What you need

  • To use this feature with a personal account, you must have a Google AI plan. Learn how to upgrade.
  • To use this feature with a work or school account, you must have a qualifying Workspace license. Learn more about feature availability for Workspace plans.
  • For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Important: When you generate videos with Gemini Apps, remember that you agreed to Google’s Terms of Service, including the Prohibited Use Policy. You must have rights to any images that you upload. Be sure not to violate others’ rights, including copyright or privacy rights. The violation of the Prohibited Use Policy or the rights of others could result in the termination of your account. Use your discretion before you rely on, publish, or use videos that Gemini Apps generate. Do not generate or share videos to deceive, harass, or harm others.

About Gemini Omni

Omni, our advanced video generator, offers the following capabilities over prior models:

  • Video to Video Edit: Upload a video and instruct the model to apply edits*.
  • Multi-turn editing: Continually edit a video within a single conversation. Each turn can include image or video references.
  • Aspect ratio control: Choose the  aspect ratio of the video before it’s created.
    • For text prompts, the default is Landscape. If you upload a reference image or video, the aspect ratio will match your uploaded content.
  • Templates: Get instant inspiration with a pre-made template. Apply a curated style to see what’s possible in a single tap.

* Uploading videos to use for video edits isn’t available in the EEA, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and some US states.

Generate a video

Important:Only upload photos you have the right to use.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the top left, click Open Sidebar   Create video .
  3. (Optional) Select a template for your video.
  4. In the text box, enter a prompt of the video you want to generate.
    • To create a video from images or videos, click Add image  and/or Add video  and select the files you would like to upload.
      • You can upload one video and up to 5 images.
    • To use your avatar in Gemini Omni videos, type 0[your Google username] in your prompt. Learn more about avatars.
  5. Click Submit .

Tips:

You can brainstorm and refine your video prompts within your main chat with Gemini before generating the video. If so, you won’t need to tap Video to create it.

  • It may take a few minutes for the video to be generated.
    • While your video is being generated, you can’t interact with the same chat. You can start a new chat and come back to view your video later.
  • You can also ask Gemini to generate audio with your video.

Edit a generated video

After generating a video, you can make edits to it with a simple prompt, such as:

  • Removing or replacing objects and characters.
  • Changing camera angles.
  • Modifying the scene.

Export or download a generated video

To export or download a video:

  1. Under the video, click Share
  2. Click Share on YouTube  or  Download video .

Use Deep Research in Gemini Apps

Use Deep Research in Gemini Apps

You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps. By default, Gemini includes Google Search as a source for your research. You can change or add other sources, like your personal Gmail or Drive, for your research. You can also upload files and add NotebookLM notebooks. Learn more about Deep Research.

Tip: If you have a Google AI Ultra plan, Deep Research reports may include visuals like charts, diagrams, schematics, and interactive simulators. Learn more about visuals and animations.

What you need

To use Deep Research, you need to:

  • Be 18 or over.

  • Be signed in to the Gemini app. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

About Deep Research models & limits

Deep Research models

Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra users can generate reports using Pro for even higher quality. All users can use Thinking for their reports. Learn how to switch between models.

Deep Research limits

In Gemini Apps, there are limits for:

  • Daily research requests
  • Number of research requests you can run at the same time

If you’re close to your limit, Gemini Apps notifies you how many research requests are left for the day.

Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra users get higher limits for how many research reports they can create. If you would like to create more research reports, learn more about limits and how to upgrade.

Start a Deep Research report

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. In the text box, click Add Files Deep Research .
  3. (Optional) To upload files or an image with your prompt, clickAdd Files Files .
    • Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps.
  4. (Optional) To choose the sources for your research, click Sources and select the sources you want to include, like Gmail or Drive.
    • Other Google services, like Gmail and Drive, are only available if the Google Workspace app is connected to Gemini Apps. Learn how to connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps.
    • Google Search is included as a source by default. To limit your research to other selected sources, deselect Google Search.
  5. In the text box, enter a question or prompt that explains what you want to research.
  6. Click Submit .
    • Gemini will create a research plan for your topic.
    • To update the research plan before you create a report, click Edit plan.
  7. Click Start research.
  8. When your report is ready, click Open.

Tips:

  • It usually takes about 5-10 minutes to generate the report since Gemini analyzes many sources. For more complex reports, it may take longer.
  • While you wait for the report, you can leave the chat. When it’s ready, Gemini will notify you:
    • In the web app: Next to the chat thread with your completed report.
    • In the mobile app: As a notification on your device. The notification may appear when your device is locked depending on your settings.

About visuals & animations in reports

Important: For now, this feature isn’t available if you include any Google Workspace services, like Gmail and Drive, as a source.

With a Google AI Ultra plan, Deep Research reports can include animations and visuals. These visuals help illustrate complex data and research findings, and make reports more comprehensive and easier to understand.

Visuals are included directly in the report and can include:

  • Charts
  • Diagrams
  • Interactive simulators

Find your research reports

Important: You can only find past research reports if your Keep Activity setting is on. Learn how to manage Gemini Apps activity.

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu .
  3. Under “Recent,” find your research chat.

Listen to your research report

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu .
  3. Under “Recent,” select the chat with your research report.
  4. On the right in the Canvas panel, click Create Audio Overview .

Tip: Learn more about Audio Overviews.

Visualize your research report

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu .
  3. Under “Recent,” select the chat with your research report.
  4. On the right in the Canvas panel, click Create.
  5. To create a custom visualization based on the report, enter the description as a prompt in the text box.

Share, export, or copy your research report

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. If your chats are hidden, at the top, click Menu .
  3. Under “Recent,” select the chat with your research report.
  4. On the right in the Canvas panel, click Share & export .
  5. Select how you want to share or export the report.
    • To share the report, click Share Canvas .
    • To export the report, click Export to Docs .
    • To copy the report text, click Copy Contents .

Create, use, & share Gems

Create & manage AI mini-apps or custom workflows as Gems from Google Labs

Create & manage AI mini-apps or custom workflows as Gems from Google Labs

You can create, edit, and share custom workflows bundled into AI mini-apps. These AI mini-apps are called Gems from Google Labs in the Gemini web app. They’re powered by Opal, a Google Labs experiment. With Gems from Google Labs , you can quickly create and edit your own AI mini-apps or remix premade ones by describing what you want with natural language.

Important: This is an experimental feature and part of ongoing work to enhance Gemini experiences. This experiment will help us gather your feedback and refine the experience further.

What you need

To use this feature, you need to:

  • Be 18 or over.
  • Sign in to the Gemini web app with a personal Google Account. For now, this feature isn’t available to users with a work or school Google Account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Important:

  • For now, this feature is available in the Gemini web app and in English only.
  • For now, you can create and edit Gems from Google Labs on a computer only.
  • For now, this feature isn’t available in the Gemini mobile app, Gemini in Google Messages, or Gemini in Chrome.

Create an AI mini-app

You can create an AI mini-app as a Gem in the Gem manager.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left, click Gems.
  3. Next to “My Gems from Labs,” click New Gem .
    • For your first time only, review the disclosures and follow the on-screen instructions to sign in to Opal. Make sure to sign in to the same personal Google Account you use for the Gemini app.
  4. In the text box at the bottom, describe the AI mini-app or workflow you want to create.
    • For inspiration, you can also click an example prompt to help you get started.
  5. Click Submit .
    • For complex apps, it can take a few minutes to create and run. You’ll need to keep the chat open until the app is ready. You can always open a new browser window or tab to start another chat.
    • When the AI mini-app is ready, Gemini will show the app’s workflow as steps and a preview of the app.
  6. Review the steps for the app and click Start app to try the app.
  7. To add or change any steps, in the text box below the steps, describe your edits.

Tips:

  • You can also edit a premade AI mini-app and make it your own. Learn how to remix a premade AI mini-app.
  • For now, you can’t convert classic Gems into Gems from Google Labs .

Find & use an AI mini-app

You can find and use both premade and your own AI mini-apps from Labs in the Gem manager.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left, click Gems.
  3. Browse the available AI mini-apps in the following 2 sections:
    • Gems made by Labs : These are premade AI mini-apps provided by Google Labs.
    • My Gems from Labs : These are AI mini-apps you have created or remixed.
  4. Click the AI mini-app you want to use.
  5. Click Start.

Learn about how your data from My Gems from Labs is handled.

Remix a premade AI mini-app

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left, click Gems.
  3. Under “Gems made by Labs ,” click the premade AI mini-app you want to edit and make your own.
  4. In the text box below the steps, describe your edits.

Share an AI mini-app & manage general access

You can share your AI mini-apps, including remixed ones, with others.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left, click Gems.
  3. Click the AI mini-app you want to share.
  4. Above the AI mini-app preview, click Share .
  5. Choose how you want to share. You can:
    • To share a link: click Copy link . Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.
    • To share with specific people by email: enter the email addresses of the people you want to share with.
    • To manage general access: under “General access,” click the Down arrow . Then choose who can access the AI mini-app.
  6. Click Save.

About general access options

These are the options for general access:

  • Public: Anyone can search on Google and get access to your AI mini-app, without signing in to their Google Account.
  • Anyone with the link: Anyone who has the link to your AI mini-app can use it, without signing in to their Google Account.
  • Private: Only people with access can open the AI mini-app.

Edit an AI mini-app

You can edit your AI mini-apps, like add or change steps, to improve how they work.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left, click Gems.
  3. Click the AI mini-app you want to edit.
  4. In the text box below the steps, describe your edits.

Tip: For more complex changes or advanced controls, above the AI mini-app preview, click Open advanced editor.

Delete an AI mini-app

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the left, click Gems.
  3. Under “My Gems from Labs ,” hover over the AI mini-app you want to delete.
  4. Click More Delete .

How to choose between a classic Gem & a Gem from Google Labs

You can decide between a classic Gem or a Gem from Google Labs based on your goals.

Classic Gems

If you want a repeatable chat with an expert on a specific topic, create a classic Gem. Similar to Gemini, classic Gems access tools and maintain context from past chats, but they follow your custom instructions and any knowledge you provide.

Example: Create a tutor Gem anchored on course materials to act as an expert on a specific subject.

Gems from Google Labs

If you want to create an interactive mini-app for a custom workflow, create a Gem from Google Labs . These Gems allow you to build light app interfaces and use multiple AI models, including image, video, music, and text models, to complete tasks.

Example: Create a Gem from Google Labs that takes lecture notes you upload and generates a custom study guide with images, a short podcast, or any other format you learn best with in one click.

Get started with Gems in Gemini Apps

Get started with Gems in Gemini Apps

Welcome to the getting started guide for Gems. Here you’ll find tips to customize Gemini Apps responses with Gems.

What are Gems?

Gems are customized versions of Gemini that help you tackle repetitive tasks or get deep expertise in new areas. When you chat with a Gem, Gemini will tailor responses to save time on repeat goals and guidelines in your Gemini web app and Gemini mobile app prompts.

What you’ll learn

Learn how to: - Use Gems - Customize premade Gems - Write instructions for custom Gems.

What you’ll need

To create and use Gems with a personal Google Account, you must also be 13 (or the applicable age in your country) or over.

Note: Some features are not yet available in the Gemini mobile app. Requirements will be listed in each section of the Gems guide.

In this guide

—, —, —, How to use Gems, Get a quick start with premade Gems, Tips for creating custom Gems

Get Started

Share a Gem from Gemini Apps

Share a Gem from Gemini Apps

You can share Gems from Gemini Apps for others to use and edit.

Important: To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Share a Gem

Important:

  • Any Gem instructions and files that you have uploaded to the Gem can be viewed by any user with access to the Gem.
  • Any user with edit access to the Gem can also update and delete the Gem. Learn more about Gem access levels.
  • NotebookLM notebooks can’t be used as a source for shared Gems.
Share with specific people
  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems.
  4. Next to the Gem that you want to share, click Share .
  5. Enter the email address you want to share with. If you use a work or school account, you can share with suggested recipients.
  6. Decide how people can use your Gem. Select one:
    • Viewer
    • Editor
  7. Optional steps:
    • If you would like to add an expiration date for the user’s access, click Add expiration.
    • In the text box, you can add a message that will be included in the notification email.
    • If you don’t want the recipient(s) to be notified, unselect Notify people.
  8. Click Send or Share.
    • If the Gem includes uploaded files, you’ll be asked to share access to the files.
    • If Notify people was selected, the recipient(s) will get an email with a link to the shared Gem.

Tips:

  • You can also follow these steps to update access levels or remove access from specific people.
  • Learn more about sharing levels.

Share access to files uploaded to the shared Gem

If you have uploaded files to the Gem, and you have permissions to share these files, you will be asked if you want to share the file(s) with the Gem.

  1. Select the level of access you want to share to the file(s):
    • Viewer
    • Commenter
    • Editor
  2. Click Share.

If you have uploaded files to a Gem, don’t share the Gem with anyone who you don’t want to view the files.

Add an expiration date

To add an expiration date and time to your shared Gem:

  1. After you’ve entered the email address of the user you would like to share with, click on the user’s role  Add expiration.
  2. Next to the expiration date and time, click Edit expiration .
  3. Select the date when access will expire for that person or group.
  4. Select the time when access will expire for that person or group.
  5. Click Done.

Transfer ownership of a Gem

Important: If you transfer ownership of a Gem, the new owner will have the ability to remove your access to the Gem.

You can transfer ownership of a Gem to another person who has access to the Gem.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems.
  4. Next to the Gem that you want to share, click Share .
  5. Find the person who you want to transfer ownership to and click on the user’s role.
    • If you haven’t shared the Gem with this person yet, complete the steps to share a Gem with a specific person before transferring ownership.
  6. Click Transfer ownership Yes.
Share a link
  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems.
  4. Next to the Gem that you want to share, click Share Copy link . Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app or an email draft.

Tip: For other users to access the Gem through the shared link, they need access to the Gem. You can give specific people access or you can change the general access of your Gem.

Learn more about sharing Gems

Sharing Gems with uploaded files

Gems with uploaded files can only be shared with device files or Google Drive files. If there are other file types uploaded in the Gem’s Knowledge section, you won’t be able to share the Gem.

Gem access levels

Important: Any user with edit access to a Gem can update or delete the Gem instructions and uploaded files. These changes may change Gemini’s response.

  • Users with this access level can:: Editor; - Share the Gem with others - Make changes to the Gem instructions and uploaded files - Delete the Gem
  • Users with this access level can:: Viewer; - Use the shared Gem - View the Gem instructions and uploaded files

Change the general access for your Gem

You can allow broad access to your Gem. These options depend on if you’re signed in to a personal, work, or school Google Account.

  • Public: Anyone can search on Google and get access to your Gem, without signing in to their Google Account. If you use a Google Account through work or school, you may not find this option.
  • Anyone with the link: Anyone who has the link can use your Gem, without signing in to their Google Account. If you use a Google Account through work or school, you may not find this option.
  • Your organization: If you use a Google Account through work or school, anyone signed in to an account in your organization can open the Gem.
  • Private: Only people with access can open the Gem.

Work or school users: Sharing Gems outside of your organization

Gems sharing is controlled by your organization’s Drive sharing settings. Drive sharing settings are managed by your organization’s Workspace administrator. Learn more about how to manage Gem sharing.

Shared Gems are saved in your Google Drive

Shared Gems are saved in a new Drive folder. Any files uploaded as part of the Gem’s uploaded files are also saved in the Drive folder.

If access to a Gem is removed for a user, the Gem will be removed from that user’s Google Drive.

To find the Gem file in Drive:

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Settings and Help Gems .
  4. Next to the Gem that you want to find in Drive, click More Locate Gem in Drive .

Work or school users: Why can’t I share a Gem?

If you don’t find the Share  option, you may not be able to share the Gem. There are two common reasons why you can’t share a Gem:

  • The Gem includes a file type that’s not supported for sharing.Learn more about sharing Gems with uploaded files.
  • Your organization has disabled Gem sharing.Your Workspace administrator can turn Gem sharing on or off. Contact your administrator to learn more.

Use Gems in Gemini Apps

Use Gems in Gemini Apps

You can create and save Gems to customize responses in Gemini Apps to your specific needs.

What you need

  • To create and use Gems with a personal Google Account, you must also be 13 (or the applicable age in your country) or over.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Important: When you create or chat with a Gem, remember that you agreed to Google’s Terms of Service, including the Prohibited Use Policy. Be sure not to violate others’ rights. Use your discretion before you rely on, publish, or use content that Gemini Apps generate. Users with a work or school account may be subject to different terms. Learn more about how to use Gemini Apps with your work or school Google Account.

Learn how to get started with Gems Use the Gems guide to get ideas for how to use Gems, learn how to get a quick start with premade Gems, and find suggestions for writing great Gem instructions. Get started

Create, use & manage Gems

Important:

  • For now, Gems can’t be used with Gemini Live.
  • The Learning coach premade Gem doesn’t currently support language learning.
Create a Gem

Important: When you create a Gem in the Gemini web app, it will appear in the Gemini mobile app and the Gemini side panel in Google Workspace.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems .
    • If you’ve never made a Gem before, first click Settings and help Gems .
  4. Click New Gem.
  5. Enter a name and instructions for your Gem.
  6. (Optional) To add sources, under “Knowledge,” click Add files .
  7. Click Save.
Other optional steps to improve your Gem

Use Gemini to re-write your instructions

After a few words, you can click Use Gemini to re-write instructions to have Gemini Apps create more comprehensive instructions for most topics. It may take a few seconds for the generated instructions to appear.

Upload files to give your Gem more context

You can add files to give your Gem more context or to reference specific docs in your chats with the Gem. Learn more about supported file types and limits.

After you add instructions, you can upload files. Under “Knowledge,” click Add files .

  • To upload a file from your device: click Upload files.
  • To add a file from your Google Drive: click Add from Drive .
    • To add files from your Drive, you need to have Keep Activity on and connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps. If it’s not connected, you’ll get the option to connect it. Learn about your Gemini Apps and Google Workspace data.
    • If you add a file from your Drive, Gemini will use the most recent version of the file. If you make changes to the file, these changes will be reflected in your Gem.
  • To add a NotebookLM notebook: click More uploads Notebooks .

Tips:

  • If you don’t want the Gem’s responses to include citations to your knowledge files, select Disable knowledge citations. This also disables citations for files uploaded in your Gem chats.
  • You may need to scroll down to find the “Knowledge” section.
  • You can edit a Gem to remove a file or add more files later. Learn how to edit your Gem.

Preview your Gem

  1. In the text box on the right, enter a prompt to preview the Gem and make edits to the instructions as needed.
  2. Click Submit .
Use a Gem in a chat
  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems .
    • If you’ve never made a Gem before, first click Settings and help  Gems .
  4. Under “My Gems,” select the Gem you want to use.
  5. In the text box at the bottom, enter your question or prompt.
  6. Click Submit .
Edit a Gem
  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems .
  4. Under “My Gems,” click the Gem that you want to edit.
  5. Make edits.
  6. Click Submit .
Delete a Gem
  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Click Open Sidebar .
  3. Click Gems .
  4. Under “My Gems,” find the Gem that you want to delete.
  5. Click Options Delete .

Share a Gem or a conversation with a Gem

You can share Gems from Gemini Apps or a conversation you had using a Gem.

  • Learn how to share a Gem.
  • Learn how to share a conversation.

Important: Gems that are shared with you aren’t automatically added to your Gem manager. Once you open the Gem and interact with it, it will be added under “My Gems”.

Try experimental Gems

Experimental Gems allow you to try out early-stage Gemini features through Gems and share feedback. Experimental Gems are in development, and their quality and availability may vary. You can leave feedback to help us improve the overall experience.

Why Gemini Apps might remove a Gem

Gemini Apps may remove Gems when our systems detect a possible violation of Google’s Terms of Service, including the Prohibited Use Policy.

Users with a school account or a work account that has Gemini Apps as a core service are subject to different terms. Learn more about how to use Gemini on your work or school Google Account.

Double-check, modify, or share responses & more

Export responses from Gemini Apps

Export responses from Gemini Apps

You can export responses from Gemini Apps to Google Workspace apps like Gmail and Google Docs. You can also export code to developer tools like Google Colab and Replit.

Important:

  • If you export content or code from Gemini Apps, the terms and policies of the service you export to will apply to that content.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Export responses to Google Workspace

Important: If you’re signed in to a Google Workspace account, your export options vary based on availability and Workspace settings. Also, export options vary by Gemini app.

Export a response to Google Docs

Below the response, click Share & export Export to Docs. This saves a new doc in Google Drive.

Export a response to Gmail

Important: This feature is only available if you have a Gmail account.

Below the response, click Share & export Draft in Gmail. This creates a new draft email in Gmail.

Export a table to Google Sheets

Important: This feature is only available for responses that have a table. Tables with images can’t be exported to Sheets.

At the bottom right of the table, click Export to Sheets. This saves the table in a new spreadsheet in Google Drive.

Export code

Export Python code to Google Colab

Important: Export to Google Colab isn’t available for Workspace accounts at this time.

Below the response, click Share & export Export to Colab. This saves a new Colab notebook in Google Drive.

Export code to Replit

Important: Exporting code to Replit isn’t available for users signed into a work or school Google Account.

  1. Below the response, click Share & export Export to Replit.
  2. Review the disclosures.
    • Exports are subject to Replit’s Privacy Policy and Replit’s Terms of Service.
    • Exports to Free Replit accounts are publicly visible on Replit.
  3. Choose whether to continue.
    • To cancel: click No, thanks.
    • To continue: click I understand, open Replit. This sends your prompt and the Gemini app’s response to Replit. If needed, sign in to your Replit account.
Supported coding languages

You can export code in the following languages to Replit:

  • Bash - C - C# - C++ - CSS - Dart - Go - HTML - Java, - JavaScript - Kotlin - PHP - Python - Ruby - Rust - SQL - Swift - TypeScript

Learn about responses from Gemini Apps

Learn about responses from Gemini Apps

Gemini Apps are continuously evolving and may sometimes produce inaccurate, offensive, or inappropriate information that doesn’t represent Google’s views.

Tips for using Gemini Apps responsibly

  • Always comply with Google’s Terms of Service and the Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy.
  • Don’t rely on responses from Gemini Apps as medical, legal, financial or other professional advice.
  • Responses from Gemini Apps don’t represent Google’s views, and should not be attributed to Google.
  • You are responsible for your use of code generated by Gemini Apps, which may be subject to an open source license.
  • Gemini Apps may provide inaccurate or inappropriate responses about people, so double-check its responses.
  • Your feedback is one of the ways Gemini Apps will learn, improve, and become more helpful and safe. Learn how to give feedback and report issues.

Is Gemini able to explain how it works?

Gemini can hallucinate and present inaccurate information as factual. One example is that Gemini can misrepresent how it works, including in response to prompts asking how it was trained or how it carries out various functions (like citing sources, or providing fresh information).

We want to be as transparent as possible about the limitations of LLMs, including providing disclaimers within the Gemini experience. If you see a hallucination or something that isn’t accurate, please click the thumbs down button and provide your feedback.

Learn more about how we handle your Gemini Apps data in the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub and the Google Privacy Policy.

Regenerate or modify responses from Gemini Apps

Regenerate or modify responses from Gemini Apps

You can regenerate Gemini App’s responses and also modify its responses. For example, you can adjust the length, simplify the language, and change the tone of a response.

Important: To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Regenerate a response

Important: You can regenerate only the most recent response in a chat.

  • To regenerate a response: Below the response, click Regenerate .
  • To switch between response versions: Below the response, click the arrows to switch between versions.

Modify a response

You can continue to chat with Gemini to modify a response. For example, you can ask Gemini to simplify the language or provide more details about your topic.

Share your chats from Gemini Apps

Share your chats from Gemini Apps

You can share a Gemini Apps conversation. To do this, create a public link and then share it, like in a messaging app, or post it on your favorite social platforms.

Important:

  • If you choose to share a chat, anyone with the link can read the chat, reshare it with others, and, except for chats created with Gems or for users under the age of 18, continue the chat with Gemini Apps on their own.
  • Also, do not enter confidential information in your conversations or any data you wouldn’t want a reviewer to see or Google to use to improve our products, services, and machine-learning technologies.
  • When you share a chat, remember that you agreed to Google’s Terms of Service, including the Prohibited Use Policy. Be sure not to violate others’ copyright or privacy rights.

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Share a chat

Important: When you share a chat, it creates a public link to that chat. Anyone with the link can read the chat, even if you didn’t share the link with them directly. Learn about what happens when you create a public link.

To share a chat on gemini.google.com:

  1. Below a response you want to share, click Share  Share conversation .
    • If you create a public link to share a chat, you share the entire conversation.
    • If you upload an image to a chat and then share the chat, the image is available and downloadable from the shared chat.
  2. Choose how you want to share:
    • To share the link: The 0 link is auto-copied. Paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.
    • To share on an available social platform: At the bottom, click the social platform and follow the on-screen instructions.

Share Gem instructions with your chat

If you used a Gem in a conversation, you can share that conversation with or without the Gem instructions included.

When you click Share , select what you want to include:

  • To share the chat without your Gem instructions: Click Share conversation .
  • To share the chat and your Gem instructions: Click Share conversation and Gem instructions .

Continue a chat

Important: For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18.

When you open a public link to someone else’s shared chat, you can continue that chat with Gemini Apps on your own. If your Keep Activity setting is on, the shared chat will be stored in your Gemini Apps Activity. Learn how to manage and delete your Gemini Apps activity.

  1. Click the public link.
  2. At the bottom, click Continue this chat.
    • If the chat was created by a user with a Google AI subscription, you can continue it only if you have a Google AI subscription. Learn more about Google AI plans.

Reshare a chat

  1. Click the public link.
  2. Near the top, next to the 0 link, click Copy public link .
  3. Paste the link where you want to share it, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.

Report a shared chat

  1. Click the public link.
  2. Below the headline, click Report .

Delete a public link

You can delete a public link that you created. Learn what happens when you delete a link.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. At the bottom, click Settings & help Your public links .
  3. At the end of the public link that you want to delete, click Delete public link .

Tip: To delete all your public links, click Delete all links.

Manage your public links

What happens when you create a public link

  • A shared chat page with a public link is created. For example, 0.
  • The shared chat will include any AI-generated artifacts from the conversation, including Canvas documents, images, and videos.
  • We don’t add your name or account to the URL address or the shared chat page.
  • The shared chat page shows the chat as it appeared when you created the public link. If you edit or continue the chat after you create a public link, the content on the shared chat page won’t change.
  • If you share a chat that was created with Gems, the Gem name will be included with the chat. You can choose to also include the instructions used to create the Gem. Learn more about Gems in Gemini Apps.
  • Anyone with the link can:
    • Read the chat, even if you didn’t share the link with them directly.
    • Reshare the chat.
    • Continue the chat with Gemini Apps on their own (except for a chat that was created with Gems or for users under the age of 18). If their Keep Activity setting is on, the chat is stored in their Gemini Apps Activity with their Google Account.

What happens when you delete a public link

If you delete a public link:

  • Anyone who tries to access the link will get a message that the chat no longer exists and will be redirected to gemini.google.com.
  • It doesn’t delete any posts with the link that you’ve made on third-party sites. To delete the post, delete it from the third party site.
  • It doesn’t delete the chat from your Gemini Apps activity. Learn how to manage & delete your Gemini Apps activity.
  • It doesn’t delete the chat from other’s Gemini Apps activity if they continue your shared chat in Gemini Apps on their own.

Fix or report a problem

You can’t share a conversation

Important:

To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

If you don’t find the Share  option, you may not be able to share the conversation because your organization has disabled conversation sharing.Your Workspace administrator can turn conversation sharing on or off. Contact your administrator to learn more.

Your public links are deleted

Your links are publicly available for as long as the associated chat is saved in your Gemini Apps Activity. If any part of a chat in a public link is deleted earlier, the public link is also deleted. Part of a chat could be deleted in these ways:

  • You manually delete it from your Gemini Apps Activity.
  • It’s automatically deleted from your Gemini Apps Activity.
  • You delete it from your pinned and recent chats.

Learn how to delete your Gemini Apps activity, change your Auto-delete settings, and delete pinned and recent chats in Gemini Apps.

View related sources from Gemini Apps

View related sources from Gemini Apps

Sometimes Gemini Apps show you sources and related content within and below its response.

Sources & related links in Gemini Apps

Gemini Apps may provide links to sources and related content for you to dig deeper. These links may include content that is related to parts of Gemini’s response, including public websites, files you have uploaded, or documents or emails from Google Workspace if you’ve connected to Workspace.

Find sources & related links

When sources are available, you can find the Sources button at the bottom of the response or in-line throughout the response. On the right, a side panel will open with the relevant links.

Why you might not be able to find the Sources button

Not all responses include related links or sources. If you don’t have the Sources button below a response, Gemini Apps didn’t provide any links for that particular response.

More info about sources & related links

How Gemini Apps cite direct quotes & code repositories

If Gemini Apps directly quotes a large amount of text from a webpage, you’ll see a link to that webpage in the sources list.

For citations to code repositories, the citation may also reference an applicable open source license.

How Gemini Apps cite sources for images from the web

If Gemini Apps’ response includes an image from the web, it will show the source and provide a link to it.

Fix a problem

Manage or delete the Gemini app on your Android device

Manage or delete the Gemini app on your Android device

If you want to change how Gemini activates on Android or just prefer a different digital assistant experience, you don’t always need to delete the Gemini mobile app. Depending on what you want, you can:

  • Change how & where you can activate Gemini
    • Remove Gemini from your Power button
    • Turn off “Hey Google” so Gemini doesn’t open by voice
    • Stop Gemini from opening when your phone is locked
  • Switch from Gemini to Google Assistant
  • Change or remove your default digital assistant app
  • Delete the Gemini mobile app
  • Manage Gemini in other Google products

Change how & where you can activate Gemini

You can change your settings to stop Gemini from opening by voice or touch, and still keep the Gemini mobile app to use directly.

Remove Gemini from your Power button

Important: The steps below vary by Android device. For steps specific to your device, check your device manufacturer’s support site.

To keep the Gemini app but stop Gemini from opening when you hold your Power or Home button, change your Gestures settings.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Settings.
  2. Tap System Gestures Press & hold power button.
  3. Select the action you want when you press and hold the power button.
    • Tip: “Digital assistant” opens your default digital assistant app.

Can’t find the setting? In your Settings app, try the search box or Search . Search for “power,” “side button,” or “gesture.” Then check results for a setting to customize your power or side button.

Turn off “Hey Google” so Gemini doesn’t open by voice

To keep the Gemini app but stop Gemini from opening when it hears “Hey Google,” turn off “Hey Google.”

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Gemini mobile app .
  2. At the left, tap Menu  your Profile picture or initial Settings Talk to Gemini hands-free.
  3. Turn off “Hey Google.”

Stop Gemini from opening when your phone is locked

Important: If you already stopped Gemini from activating by voice or touch, you must unlock your phone and open the Gemini mobile app to use Gemini.

If the Gemini app starts when you don’t want it to when your phone is locked, you can turn off Gemini on your lock screen.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open your Gemini mobile app .
  2. At the left, tap Menu  your Profile picture or initial Settings Gemini on lock screen.
  3. Turn off Use Gemini without unlocking.

Switch from Gemini to Google Assistant

You can switch to using Google Assistant as your primary assistant on your phone or tablet in your settings.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open your Gemini mobile app .
  2. At the  left, tap Menu  your Profile picture or initial Switch to Google Assistant Google Assistant.
  3. In the “Switch to Google Assistant?” dialog, tap Switch.

What happens if you switch to Google Assistant

If you switch to Google Assistant as your primary assistant:

  • When you say, “Hey Google,” or activate your mobile assistant by touch (like when you press and hold the power button), Google Assistant will respond.
  • If your Web & App Activity is turned on, data from your interactions with Google Assistant will be saved to your Google Account. Learn more about how Google Assistant works with your data.
  • Data saved in your Gemini Apps Activity will not automatically be deleted, but you can review and delete it anytime.

Change or remove your default digital assistant app

Important: The steps below vary by Android device. For steps specific to your device, check your device manufacturer’s support site.

Your default digital assistant app is the primary assistant app on your device, like Gemini or Google Assistant. You can activate it by touch or voice to get quick help with navigation, answers to questions, device control, and much more. You can change, remove, or set a default digital assistant app at any time.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Settings.
  2. Tap Apps Default apps Digital assistant app.
  3. Tap Default digital assistant app.
  4. Select a different assistant app or None.
    • “Google” is selected if you use either Google Assistant or Gemini as your default digital assistant app.

Can’t find the setting? In your Settings app, try the search box or Search . Search for “digital assistant app.”

Delete the Gemini mobile app

Important: Deleting the Gemini mobile app doesn’t automatically remove Gemini as your device’s default digital assistant. To keep the app but stop it from activating by your voice or shortcuts, like the power button, review the other options above.

If you want to delete the Gemini mobile app from your device, follow the steps to delete apps on your Android device.

Manage Gemini in other Google products

  • Delete your Gemini chat in Google Messages.
  • Manage Gemini in Chrome settings. This includes steps to remove the Gemini icon from your Chrome browser and desktop system tray or menu bar.
  • Manage smart features for Google Workspace. This includes Gemini in Workspace apps like Gmail, Docs, and more.

Send feedback or report a problem with Gemini Apps

Send feedback or report a problem with Gemini Apps

If you get a response that’s inaccurate or that you feel is unsafe, you can give feedback on that response to let us know. If you have a general issue with Gemini Apps, or want to tell us about your experience, you can report a problem.

Important: When you submit feedback, the associated conversation, like your prompts and the Gemini app’s responses, is added as part of your feedback. Any included content, such as files and images you upload, as well as your personal content that Gemini got from Connected Apps is collected with your feedback and used consistent with Google Privacy Policy.

Give feedback on a response

Important:

  • To give feedback on a response, you need to sign in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Users with a work account that has access to Pro, and users with a school account, will not be able to add additional feedback or attach content.

Your feedback helps make Gemini Apps more helpful, accurate, and safe.

  1. Below the response from Gemini Apps, click Good response or Bad response .
  2. Optionally, you can select a reason, enter additional feedback, and/or choose to include the files and/or images uploaded before this response with your feedback.
    • Tip: You can help us understand your feedback better when you select a reason. For example, if you select Bad response because it’s unsafe or offensive, selecting Offensive / Unsafe helps us understand your rating.
  3. If you provide additional feedback, click Submit.

Report a problem or send general feedback

Important: To report a problem or general feedback, you need to sign in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. At the bottom, click Settings & help Send feedback .
  3. Enter your feedback. You can choose to add a screenshot to help us better understand the issue.
  4. At the bottom, click Send.

Report a legal issue

To report a Gemini web app’s response for legal reasons:

  1. Below the response, click More Report legal issue.
  2. Select the reason you wish to report content.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions.
