Control your Android mobile device & apps with Utilities

Control your Android mobile device & apps with Utilities

When you use Gemini as your mobile assistant on  your Android device, you can ask it to do certain actions for you with the Utilities app. For example, you can ask it to manage your alarms and timers, open apps, read and reply to notifications, control your media, and more.

Important:

  • The Utilities app isn’t available in Gemini Apps on iOS devices, the Gemini web app, or Live chats.
  • Gemini works with the Utilities app, whether the Keep Activity setting is on or off.
  • Some features or actions aren’t available depending on your settings. Learn how to manage your settings for the Utilities app.

Manage settings

Utilities is designed to work automatically with Gemini on Android. You can disconnect the Utilities app anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

To enable the full Utilities app functionality, you can:

  • Turn on the Google app’s Notification read, reply & control to allow Gemini to read and reply to notifications you receive on your Android device. Learn how to manage the Gemini app’s access to your notifications.
  • Set the Google app as your default device assistant if you want Gemini (hosted by the Google app) to help you with the following additional actions:
    • Turn on or turn off device settings such as Airplane mode, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, NFC, Do Not Disturb, Battery Saver, flashlight and more.
    • Control the volume of your phone or tablet
    • Take a photo or screenshot
    • Power off your phone or tablet

Tip: Gemini can work with Utilities without turning on these permissions, but the actions listed above will not work.

Set & manage alarms, timers & stopwatch in your clock app

Important:

  • For HONOR, OnePlus, OPPO, Samsung, TECNO, and Xiaomi mobile devices, the Gemini mobile app uses the manufacturer’s clock app.
  • For other mobile devices, if the Clock app by Google is enabled on your device, the Gemini mobile app uses it over any other clock app.
  • For third-party clock apps, you can ask the Gemini mobile app to set, check, update, and delete alarms and timers. Other actions aren’t supported.

Manage alarms, timers & stopwatch based on your conversation

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to set and manage your alarms and timers based on your conversation or other information. Try these example prompts:

  • Set an alarm so I can wake up for [event, activity].
  • I need to focus on [activity, task] for [length of time]. Set a timer for this.
  • Show my alarms. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Delete the [time] alarm.
  • When does [activity, event] start? [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Set an alarm for [hours] hours earlier.
  • I want to time my run. Start stopwatch.

Set & manage your alarms

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to set and manage your alarms.

  • Action: Set; Example prompts: - Set alarm at [time] - Set alarm in [minutes]
  • Action: Modify; Example prompts: - Change [alarm name] alarm to [time]
  • Action: Check; Example prompts: - When is my next alarm? - Show my alarms - Tip: To show more alarms, tap Show more .
  • Action: Silence; Example prompts: - Snooze alarm - Stop
  • Action: Disable; Example prompts: - Cancel [time] alarm for [day] - Remove all my alarms
  • Action: Delete; Example prompts: - Delete [time, alarm name] alarm

Set & manage your timers

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to set and manage your timers.

  • Action: Set; Example prompts: - Set timer for [length of time] - Add another timer for [length of time]
  • Action: Modify; Example prompts: - Change timer’s name to [new name] - Add [length of time] to this timer
  • Action: Check; Example prompts: - How much time is left on my timer? - Show my timers
  • Action: Pause; Example prompts: - Pause my timer
  • Action: Resume; Example prompts: - Resume my timer - Unpause my timer
  • Action: Reset; Example prompts: - Reset timer - Restart my timer
  • Action: Silence; Example prompts: - Stop
  • Action: Delete; Example prompts: - Delete the timer

Start & manage your stopwatch

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to start and resume your stopwatch. For now, if you ask Gemini to perform other stopwatch actions, like pause or reset, it opens your stopwatch where you can complete those actions.

  • Action: Start; Example prompts: - Start a stopwatch
  • Action: Resume; Example prompts: - Resume my stopwatch

Control health and fitness apps with the Gemini mobile app

You can ask the Gemini mobile app, including Gemini on your smart watch, to control health and fitness apps like Fitbit and Samsung Health. For example, you can ask Gemini:

  • To start, stop, pause, and resume a workout.
  • What your heartrate is.
  • What your step count is.

Note: When you ask Gemini to help with health and fitness tasks, it does not log any sensitive health data.

Manage & control your device with the Gemini mobile app

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to manage or control your device’s apps and settings.

Request multiple actions at once

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to perform multiple actions in one prompt. Try these example prompts:

  • Turn my media volume and notification volume to [percentage] and turn on battery saver.
  • Take a photo with a 10s timer

Open websites, apps & settings

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to open a website, your apps, and settings menus. Try these prompts:

  • Open [URL name]
  • Open [app name]
  • Open [name of settings] settings

Check & control your device features

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to do the following actions on your device:

  • Action: Turn features on or off; Example prompts: - Turn [on, off] flashlight - Turn [on, off] battery saver
  • Action: Check & adjust volume; Example prompts: - Tell me the volume - Volume [percentage] - Turn [up, down] volume
  • Action: Adjust display brightness; Example prompts: - Decrease brightness to [percentage]
  • Action: Check battery level; Example prompts: - What’s my battery level?
  • Action: Power off & restart device; Example prompts: - Power off device - Restart my device

Take photos & screenshots

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to take a photo or screenshot. Try these examples:

  • Take a selfie
  • Take a picture in [seconds]
  • Take a screenshot

Control your media playback

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to control media playback on your device.

  • Action: Pause or stop; Example prompts: - Pause - Pause the [music, video] - Stop the [music, video]
  • Action: Resume; Example prompts: - Resume - Continue playing
  • Action: Replay; Example prompts: - Replay - Restart [music, video]
  • Action: Next; Example prompts: - Skip - Next - Next [song, video]
  • Action: Previous; Example prompts: - Previous - Play previous
  • Action: Rate; Example prompts: - Give this [song, video] a thumbs up

Read & reply to messages in notifications

Important: These actions are being released gradually, so they might not be available to you just yet.

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to read and reply to messages in your notifications, like from messaging and social media apps. For now, the Gemini mobile app cannot read or play voice, image, or video messages.

Tip: To save you time, the Gemini mobile app summarizes lengthy messages or conversations. You can always ask it to read messages in full.

  • Action: Read new messages; Example prompts: - Do I have any new messages? - Read my messages. - Play my notifications. - Read my latest notification. - Check my recent messages.
  • Action: Read entire messages; Example prompts: - Read all my messages in full. - Play all my messages from Dave verbatim.
  • Action: Read messages from a specific contact; Example prompts: - What messages did I get from Sasha? - Play my notifications from Kalani.
  • Action: Read messages from a group; Example prompts: - Read my messages from my Family group.
  • Action: Read messages from a specific app; Example prompts: - Read all my DMs from Instagram. - Play my WhatsApp messages.
  • Action: Reply to a message; Example prompts: - Read my messages from my mom. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Reply saying sounds good. - Read my messages from my Project group. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Reply saying let’s meet at 1PM.
  • Action: Draft a reply to a message; Example prompts: - What messages did I get from Sasha? [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Reply saying no, but in a nice way.
Manage the Gemini app’s access to your notifications

Important: Some steps may vary by device and Android version.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open your device’s settings.
  2. Tap Apps Special app access Notification read, reply & control Google.
  3. Turn Allow notification access on or off.

If the steps above don’t work on your device, try these steps:

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open your device’s settings.
  2. Tap Apps More Special access Notification access.
  3. Turn Google on or off.
Allow the Gemini app to read and reply to notifications on your lock screen

To allow the Gemini app to read and reply to notifications on your lock screen, you need to turn on Gemini mobile app’s lock screen settings and your device’s sensitive notifications setting.

Step 1: Turn your Gemini mobile app’s lock screen setting on

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Gemini mobile app .
  2. At the  left, tap Menu   your Profile picture or Initial Settings.
  3. Tap Gemini on lock screen.
  4. Turn Use Gemini without unlocking on.
  5. Turn Make calls and send messages without unlocking on.

Step 2: Turn on sensitive notifications in your device’s settings

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open your device’s settings.
  2. Tap Notifications.
  3. Turn Sensitive notifications on.

Tip: You can turn off Gemini Apps lock screen settings or the sensitive notifications setting at any time.

What the Gemini mobile app can’t do

  • Turn closed captioning on or off
  • Change the language for media
  • Find and open specific pages on a website
  • Change Gemini’s language
  • Use Find My Device

Browse or search for screenshots in Pixel Screenshots

Important: This feature is available in English only and with the Pixel Screenshots app installed. Learn more about the Pixel Screenshots app.

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to find a screenshot for you in the Pixel Screenshots app. For example:

  • Search for [item, object, content type] in Pixel Screenshots
  • Show me my [collection name] in Pixel Screenshots
  • Check Pixel Screenshots. [your query].

What’s available on lock screen

If your Gemini on lock screen setting is on, you can also get Gemini’s help with the following actions when your device is locked:

  • Set and silence alarms
  • Set and stop timers
  • Turn the following features on or off:
    • Flashlight
    • Bluetooth
    • Do Not Disturb
    • Battery Saver
  • Check your device’s volume and battery level
  • Power off or restart your device
  • Take a photo and screenshot
  • Control media, like pause or replay a video
  • Read & reply to messages in notifications

Control your smart home devices with the Gemini mobile app

Control your smart home devices with the Gemini mobile app

You can control smart home devices that your Google Account can access, including those added later, by connecting the Google Home app to the Gemini mobile app. This includes the following smart home devices:

  • Lights & power, like lights, outlets, and switches
  • Climate control, like air conditioning units, thermostats, heaters, and fans
  • Window coverings, like curtains, blinds, and shutters
  • Media devices, like TVs and speakers
  • Other smart devices, like washers, coffee makers, and vacuums

Tip: You can also broadcast messages to your smart home devices with the Gemini mobile app. Learn how to broadcast messages.

What you need

To connect Google Home to Gemini Apps on an Android phone or tablet, you need to:

  • Use the Gemini mobile app, including as your mobile assistant. Learn more about the Gemini mobile app.

  • Have Keep Activity on. Gemini can’t connect to Google Home when this setting is off.

  • Be signed in to the Gemini mobile app with a personal Google Account. For now, this feature isn’t available if you sign in to the Gemini app with a work or school Google Account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

Important:

  • For now, the Google Home app isn’t available in Gemini in Google Messages, the Gemini web app, or Live chats.
  • You can also say ‘Hey Google’ to ask Gemini to use a connected app. If “Hey Google” doesn’t work, check if “Hey Google” and Voice Match are set up.

Before you connect Google Home to Gemini Apps

Important: Home controls are for convenience only, not safety- or security-critical purposes. Don’t rely on Gemini for requests that could result in injury or harm if they fail to start or stop.

Gemini can’t help you with some actions on security devices, like unlocking a door for you. For unsupported actions, the Gemini mobile app opens the Google Home app or gives you a link to it where you can control these devices.

If you connect Google Home to Gemini, your Gemini mobile app can:

  • Help you control and manage the same homes and devices in the Google Home app as your signed-in Google Account. This includes any homes and devices that are added later.
  • Access information about smart home devices that you may share with other household members in the Google Home app. Remember to keep household members in mind when you control these devices with the Google Home app in Gemini. Learn more about household members.

Connect Google Home to Gemini Apps

  1. On your phone or tablet, open the Gemini mobile app .
  2. Make sure you’re signed in to the same account you use with Google Home.
  3. Ask the Gemini mobile app to perform an action on a smart home device, like 0.
    • Tip: If Gemini doesn’t use the Google Home app, you can include 0 in your prompt.
  4. If you haven’t connected Google Home to Gemini Apps, you’ll get the option to connect it.
    • If you connect Google Home to Gemini Apps, you give Gemini permission to access and control the same homes and devices as this account in the Google Home app. This includes any homes and devices added or shared with you later.
  5. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tips:

  • You can connect or disconnect the Google Home app anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

  • You can ask the Gemini mobile app to perform certain actions while your phone is locked if Gemini on lock screen is on. Learn how to turn on Gemini on lock screen.

  • On Android phones and tablets, you can also ask the Gemini mobile app to start a routine by voice or typed commands.

    • Unsupported starters and actions: Some starters and actions aren’t supported when you use a routine with Gemini. If an action isn’t supported, Gemini tells you. This includes multi-step actions that require a back-and-forth chat, like when Gemini asks, “What time do you want the alarm set for?”
    • Voice and text responses only: For actions, like asking for the weather, Gemini now responds with voice and text only. It no longer displays visual information cards, like maps or detailed weather graphs.
Examples
  • Set the dining room for a romantic date night
  • Set the AC to a good temperature for sleeping
  • Turn off the bedroom TV and lights
  • The sun is too bright in the living room (to close window coverings)
  • Help me clean up the kitchen (to start vacuum)

Control smart home devices

There are a lot of smart home devices that the Google Home app can help you control. The devices listed below are just a few of the common ones that are supported.

Control lights & power

Lights

Control window coverings

What Gemini can’t do with the Google Home app

Create & manage your calendar events with Gemini Apps

Create & manage your calendar events with Gemini Apps

You can ask Gemini Apps to create, find, and edit your events in Google Calendar, HONOR Calendar, OPPO Calendar, Samsung Calendar, TECNO Calendar, and Xiaomi Calendar.

What you need

To connect your calendar apps to Gemini Apps, you need to:

  • Be signed in to the Gemini app. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.

  • Have Keep Activity on. Gemini can’t connect to these apps when this setting is off.

Important:

  • The supported calendar apps aren’t available in Gemini in Google Messages.
  • Gemini Apps can hallucinate responses or provide outdated information. To check the information, click and review the sources listed after the response.

Use Google Calendar in Gemini Apps

To create and manage your Google Calendar events, you’ll need to connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Make sure you’re signed in to the same account you use with Google Workspace.
  3. Ask the Gemini app to create or show an event from Google Calendar.
    • You can also ask Gemini to create and manage events on your secondary and shared calendars in Google Calendar.
    • Gemini creates events on your default calendar unless you specify a different calendar.
    • Tip: To tell Gemini Apps to specifically use Google Calendar, add 0 to your prompt.
  4. If Google Workspace isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  5. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tip: You can disconnect the Google Workspace app in your Connected Apps settings.

What Gemini Apps can’t do

Gemini Apps can’t perform certain actions in your calendar for you, like:

  • Add or invite people to events
  • Add or update the location or description of an existing event

Tip: You can always edit your calendars and event details, like guests, location, and description, in your calendar app, like Google Calendar.

Create a calendar event

Create an event by giving specific details

  • Create an event for [time] on [day, date] to [activity, task].
  • Create an event for [event description] at [time] on [day, date], add a description saying [event details].
  • Add [event name] to my calendar on [day] at [time] and add a description saying [reminder, details].

Create an event based on your conversation

  • Show me the email that [sender name] sent about [event, activity]. [Image: After Gemini’s response:]Add the event to my calendar.
  • Check my calendar and see if I’m free for the concert in [location] this year.
  • Create an itinerary for a 1-day trip in San Francisco with times. [Image: After Gemini’s response:]Add them to my calendar
  • Add these to my calendar.

Tips:

  • To add an event, you can include “Add this to my calendar” or “@Google Calendar add this event” in your prompt.
  • To undo an action, select Undo in the confirmation notification, or open and edit the event linked below the response.
    • Some things can’t be undone, like an email sent to event guests when an event is modified.
    • If you created an event with Gemini Live on in the background, Gemini can’t undo the event.

Find your calendar events

Find events for a specific day or date range

  • What’s on my calendar today?
  • When’s my first meeting tomorrow?
  • How many meetings do I have today?
  • What am I doing this weekend?

Find events based on event details

  • When was the last time I met with [name]?
  • When is my next meeting with [name]?
  • When is my meeting about [meeting description]?
  • Where is [event] tonight?

Tip: You can view or edit an event in your calendar app by selecting the event in the chat.

Edit or cancel your calendar events

Edit your calendar events

Important: For now, Gemini Apps can’t edit some event details, like the location or description of an event. You can always edit your events in your calendar app, like Google Calendar.

  • Create an event called [event name] at [location, place] for [day] at [time]. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] The event is actually on [new day]. Can you change that?
  • Reschedule [event name, event description] on [day] to [new day] [new time].

You can use the Google Play connected app within the Gemini mobile app on Android to discover, find, and install apps, as well as make in-app purchases. Just ask Gemini, and it’ll use the Google Play connected app to help you.

What you need

To connect Google Play to Gemini Apps, you need to:

  • Be 18 or over.
  • Have the Google Play Store app installed on your Android phone or tablet.

Connect Google Play to Gemini Apps

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open the Gemini mobile app .

  3. Ask Gemini to find an app from Google Play, like 0?

  5. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Get help with your shopping in Gemini Apps

Get help with your shopping in Gemini Apps

You can use Gemini Apps as your personal AI-powered shopping assistant. Gemini uses information from Google’s Shopping Graph to help you find products, compare options, and make purchase decisions.

What you need

To get help with your shopping in Gemini Apps, you need to:

  • Be 18 or over.
  • Be signed in with a personal Google Account. This feature isn’t available if you sign in to a work, school, or supervised Google Account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Have Keep Activity on.

Important: For now, shopping with Gemini Apps:

  • Is only available in the Gemini mobile app, the Gemini web app at gemini.google.com, and Gemini in Chrome.
  • Works with eligible merchants with some product restrictions, including those that require ID verification like alcohol or tobacco, and digital goods products that require customization or special delivery requirements.

Supported countries & languages

For now, shopping with Gemini Apps is only available in following countries:

  • Australia
  • Brazil
  • Canada
  • India
  • Japan
  • Indonesia
  • Mexico
  • US

For now, shopping with Gemini Apps is only available in following languages:

  • French
  • English
  • Hindi
  • Japanese
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Find & compare products

You can ask Gemini Apps to help you find what you’re looking for.

In the Gemini web app

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Ask Gemini about a product you’re shopping for.

Tip: In Gemini’s response, you can click a product card for more details, like descriptions, reviews, buying options.

In Gemini in Chrome

  1. On your computer, open Chrome.
  2. At the top of your browser, click Ask Gemini .
  3. In Gemini in Chrome, ask about a product you’re shopping for.

Tip: In Gemini’s response, you can click a product card for more details, like descriptions, reviews, buying options, and more. This opens a new tab.

Examples

To begin your shopping journey with Gemini, use natural language prompts such as:

  • Find me a new laptop for college under $800.
  • Compare the [Product A] headphones with the [Product B] headphones.
  • I want to find a new carry-on suitcase. Help me compare options by weight, material and price.

How Gemini Apps help you discover or compare products

When you ask Gemini Apps about products, you can get:

  • Visually-rich results: Gemini Apps can show you products with clear images and key information.
  • Grouping by theme: Gemini Apps can organize products into groups to make it easier to explore related items.
  • Product comparisons: Gemini Apps can compare multiple products based on the aspects you select to help you make an informed decision.
  • Product links: Gemini Apps can give direct links to products.
  • Personalized shopping experiences: Gemini Apps can provide relevant and personalized product recommendations using Personal Intelligence. Learn more about eligibility.

Make purchases from eligible merchants & manage your orders from the Gemini web app

Important: To make purchases in Gemini with Google Pay, you must have an address and valid payment method saved to your Google Account. Learn how to manage your addresses and payment methods.

Buy a product from your Gemini chat

You can buy products from select merchants from your Gemini chat.

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Ask Gemini about a product you’re shopping for.
  3. In Gemini’s response, select the product you want to buy.
    • There’s a “Buy” button on product listings that are eligible for purchase within the Gemini web app.
  4. Select Buy. This opens the checkout process.
  5. Review your order details.
    • Your payment method and shipping address is prefilled from Google Pay.
  6. Select Pay with GPay.
    • Your payment information is encrypted and kept private as Gemini makes the purchase for you.
    • Any post-purchase follow ups, such as order confirmation emails, will come directly from the merchant.
Find & manage orders you made with Gemini

Find orders and check order status & other details

  1. Go to google.com.
  2. At the top, select your Profile picture or Initial My orders.
  3. Select an order to check its details, including:
    • Order status (e.g., Processing, Shipped, Delivered)
    • Merchant information
    • Order total and payment method used
    • Order ID
    • And more

Go to My orders

Remove an order from “My orders”

Important: This only removes the order from “My orders”. It doesn’t cancel, refund or stop shipping for your order.

  1. Go to My orders.
  2. On the right side of your order, select More   Delete from this list .
  3. Select Delete to confirm your action in the pop-up.

Need support with a purchase? To cancel an order, process a return, or address specific issues with an item, contact the merchant who you made the purchase from directly.

Fix problems with your orders

If there is a problem with an order, you may get one of these error messages:

“Something went wrong”

If you find your order, it was successful and you don’t need to do anything.

If you don’t find your order, check your email for a confirmation from the merchant. This may take some time to appear. If you don’t get a confirmation email from the merchant, your order wasn’t placed. You can visit the merchant’s website directly to place your order.

“Order not found”

  1. Go to google.com.
  2. At the top, select your Profile picture or Initial My orders.

Tip: You can also go directly to My orders.

If you find your order, it was successful and you don’t need to do anything.

If you don’t find your order, check your email for a confirmation from the merchant. This may take some time to appear. If you don’t get a confirmation email from the merchant, your order wasn’t placed. You can visit the merchant’s website directly to place your order.

“Purchase failed”

You can get this error message for a few reasons.

  • The merchant may not have the item in stock.
  • You may be missing required info to complete the order. Add the info or try the order again.
  • Your payment method may be declined. You’ll need to try a different payment method.

    • Your organization’s Workspace administrator must enable access to apps in Gemini.

Important:

  • After you upload a GitHub repository, changes to the repository aren’t synced to Gemini. In Gemini Apps, the repository remains in the same state as when it was uploaded.
  • For now, the features below aren’t available on mobile devices, including the Gemini mobile app or Gemini in Messages.

Import & ask about a GitHub repository

Important: You can add only one repository, with up to 5,000 files and a maximum size of 100 MB, to a chat.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. In the text box at the bottom, click Add file More Uploads Import code .
  3. Enter the GitHub repository or branch URL.
  4. Click Import.
  5. Follow any on-screen instructions to import the repository.
    • To import a private repository, your GitHub account that has access to that repository must be linked to your Google Account. If it isn’t, you’ll get the option to link it.
  6. Enter your question or prompt.
  7. Click Submit .

Tip: After you add a repository to a chat on a computer, you can continue that chat in the Gemini mobile app and Gemini web app on your mobile devices.

Examples
  • What external libraries are used in the attached code?
  • How can the attached code be more efficient?
  • Write event handlers for the attached code to recommend products to users.

Disconnect the GitHub app

Important: If you disconnect the GitHub app, it doesn’t unlink your GitHub account from your Google Account. Gemini won’t use your GitHub account while the app is disconnected.

The GitHub app is connected the first time you try to import a GitHub repository. You can connect or disconnect it anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

Go to Connected Apps settings

Unlink your GitHub account from your Google Account

You can unlink your GitHub account and revoke permissions to repositories in your Connected Apps settings. This unlinks your GitHub account from your Google Account and all Google services.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.

  2. At the bottom, click Settings & help Connected Apps .

    • If you don’t find “Connected Apps,” first click Personal Intelligence Connected Apps.

  3. Under “GitHub,” click Learn more.

  4. Click Disconnect.

Go to Connected Apps settings

Tips:

  • You can also unlink your GitHub account from your Google Account’s third-party connections page. Learn how to manage third-party connections.
  • If you unlink your GitHub account, you can still import public GitHub repositories, but can’t import private ones. To use a private repository again, link your GitHub account and import it again.

What Gemini can’t do with the GitHub app

  • Retrieve commit history, pull requests, or other metadata
  • Read a repository by including a GitHub URL directly in your prompt
  • Write to a code repository

How your data is handled

Learn more about how your data is handled when Gemini works with Connected Apps.

Make calls & send messages on WhatsApp with the Gemini mobile app on Android

Make calls & send messages on WhatsApp with the Gemini mobile app on Android

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to make calls and send messages with WhatsApp. Just ask in a way that’s natural and conversational to you. You can even ask it to help you compose and edit your messages.

To help you quickly get started, WhatsApp in Gemini will work automatically on your device depending on your device app permissions and other settings. If you upgraded to Gemini from Google Assistant and your Personal Results setting was turned off, you may need to connect WhatsApp in your Connected Apps settings.

Important: To check if WhatsApp in Gemini is connected, check your Connected Apps settings. You can disconnect the WhatsApp app from that settings page at any time. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

Before you use WhatsApp in Gemini

When you use WhatsApp in Gemini:

  • Gemini cannot read or summarize your WhatsApp message history or any messages directly in WhatsApp. Learn more about what Gemini can’t do with WhatsApp.
    • Instead, you can ask Gemini to read or reply to messages in your notifications, including those from WhatsApp. To do this, Gemini uses the Utilities app. Learn more about the Utilities app.
  • Any data WhatsApp receives to fulfill your request, including messages that you send through WhatsApp using the Gemini app, are subject to WhatsApp’s Privacy Policy.

What you need

  • Android phone or tablet.
  • WhatsApp Messenger app. Get it on Google Play.
  • The Gemini app, including as your mobile assistant. Learn more about the Gemini mobile app.
    • The WhatsApp app is not supported on Gemini in Google Messages or the Gemini web app.
  • Save contact info from your signed-in devices on.
    • Learn how to sync your device contacts to your Google Account.

Important:

  • For now, this feature isn’t available in Live chats.
  • Connected Apps are not available when using features powered directly by Google Assistant.
  • You can use Gemini to make calls or send messages with WhatsApp, even when Keep Activity is off. If Keep Activity is off, a WhatsApp request that requires certain other apps or Google services may not work. For example, asking Gemini to “call the nearest pizza place” would require Google Maps, which isn’t available if Keep Activity is off.
    • You can only use Gemini to make calls or send messages on your connected smartwatch when Keep Activity is on.

Connect the WhatsApp app

Important: WhatsApp in Gemini is designed to work automatically with the Gemini mobile app. You can disconnect WhatsApp anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

  1. Ask the Gemini app to call or message one of your contacts in WhatsApp.
    • Tip: To tell the Gemini app to specifically use WhatsApp, include 0 in your prompt.
  2. If the WhatsApp app isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tip: You can also say ‘Hey Google’ to ask Gemini to use a connected app. If ‘Hey Google’ doesn’t work, check if ‘Hey Google’ and Voice Match are set up.

Examples
  • Help me write a congratulations message to [contact name] on their 25th anniversary. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Actually, make it a haiku. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Send it to [contact name] in WhatsApp.

Make a call

Try these example prompts:

  • I need to talk to [contacts name]. Can you call them on WhatsApp?
  • Call [contact first name]’s [mobile, home, work] number with WhatsApp.
  • @WhatsApp call [contact full name].

Send a message

Try these example prompts:

  • Send a WhatsApp message to [contact name].
  • Text [contact name] [message] on WhatsApp.
  • Ask [contact name] [question] on WhatsApp.

Tip: You don’t always need to mention “WhatsApp” in your prompt. By default, the Gemini mobile app uses the last app it used to call or message the same contact.

Fix a problem

Gemini cannot send messages or make calls with WhatsApp

If WhatsApp isn’t working, try the following steps:

  1. Check that the WhatsApp Messenger app is installed on your device.
  2. Check that Save contact info from your signed-in devices is turned on.
  3. Check that the Google app has Contacts permission. Learn how to manage Android app permissions.

Manage settings

Important: Even if you disconnect the WhatsApp app, the Gemini mobile app can still access:

  • Your device contacts if the Google app has Contacts permission. Learn how to manage Android app permissions.
  • Your notifications if the Utilities app is connected. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

Sync your device contacts to your Google Account

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini .
  2. At the left, tap Menu  your Profile pic or Initial Settings Contact info from your devices.
  3. Turn on Save contact info from your signed-in devices.

Learn how to manage contact info from your devices.

Go to setting

Manage Android app permissions

For a better experience, you can also choose to allow access to your Contacts to call or message device contacts that aren’t synced to your Google Account

  1. Touch and hold the Google app .
  2. Tap App info Permissions.
  3. To change a permission setting, tap it, then choose Allow or Don’t allow.

What Gemini can’t do with WhatsApp

The following actions aren’t supported by the WhatsApp app in Gemini:

  • Read or summarize your messages directly from WhatsApp.
  • Send or read images, gifs, or memes in your messages.
  • Send or play audio or videos in your messages.
  • Read or reply to messages in your device notifications.
    • Gemini only uses the Utilities app to read or reply to messages in your notifications, including those from WhatsApp. Learn more about the Utilities app.

About your data & WhatsApp

  • The Gemini mobile app uses your data to help it choose the most helpful app to use and connect you with the right person. Learn more about your data and communication apps.
  • If you delete your activity related to WhatsApp from your Gemini Apps Activity, it also deletes whether WhatsApp was the last app you used for specific contacts. The next time you ask Gemini to call or message someone and prefer to use WhatsApp, specify WhatsApp in your prompt.
  • If you use WhatsApp with Gemini, any data WhatsApp receives to fulfill your request, including messages that you send through WhatsApp using the Gemini app, are subject to WhatsApp’s Privacy Policy.

Learn more about how your data is handled when Gemini works with Connected Apps.

Make calls with the Gemini mobile app on Android

Make calls with the Gemini mobile app on Android

You can ask the Gemini mobile app, including Gemini as your mobile assistant, to make phone calls for you with the Phone app. With the Phone app, Gemini can use your device’s calling app to call your contacts, businesses, and phone numbers directly.

What you need

  • An Android phone or tablet.
  • An active mobile phone plan for your device.
  • The Gemini app, including as your mobile assistant. Learn more about the Gemini mobile app.
    • The Phone app isn’t available in Gemini in Google Messages or the Gemini web app.
  • Save contact info from your signed-in devices on.
    • Learn how to sync your device contacts to your Google Account.
  • Phone Android app permission given to the Google app. Learn how to manage Android app permissions.

Important:

  • For now, this feature isn’t available in Live chats.
  • Connected Apps are not available while using features powered directly by Google Assistant.
  • Don’t use the Phone app in Gemini to call emergency services. Instead, use your device’s calling app directly to make an emergency call.
  • On Android devices, you can ask Gemini to make calls at any time, even when Keep Activity is off. If Keep Activity is off, a call request that requires certain other apps or Google services may not work. For example, asking Gemini to “call the nearest pizza place” would require Google Maps, which isn’t available if Keep Activity is off.
    • On connected smartwatches, the Phone app isn’t available if Keep Activity is off.

Connect the Phone app

Important: The Phone app in Gemini is designed to work automatically with the Gemini mobile app. You can disconnect the Phone app anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini .
  2. Ask it to make a call.
    • If Gemini doesn’t use the Phone app, add 0 to your prompt. If the app isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tip: You can also say ‘Hey Google’ to ask Gemini to use a connected app. If ‘Hey Google’ doesn’t work, check if ‘Hey Google’ and Voice Match are set up.

Make a phone call

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to make a phone call for you, in a natural and conversational way.

Tip: By default, the Gemini mobile app uses the last app it used to call the same contact. If the Gemini app uses the Phone app, it uses your default phone app on your Android device. Learn how to change your default phone app.

Call based on your conversation

Try these example prompts:

  • Show me some good Thai restaurants nearby. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Summarize the reviews for the second one. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Ok, call this restaurant.
  • Help me negotiate buying a new car over the phone before going to the dealer. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Call [car dealership] in [city].

Call your contacts & phone numbers

Try these example prompts:

  • I need to talk to [contacts name]. Can you call them?
  • Call [contact first name]’s [mobile, home, work] number.
  • Call [contact full name].
  • Can you call [phone number]?
  • Call my voicemail.

Gemini can make a call based on a relationship (e.g., “call my sister”) if the relationship is saved in your instructions for Gemini.

Call a business or organization

Try these example prompts:

  • Call the closest [cuisine] restaurant
  • Call [business with multiple locations] [Image: After Gemini’s response:] The one on [street name]
  • Call [business or organization name]
  • Call my district representative
  • Can you call the nearest hospital

Manage settings

Sync your device contacts to your Google Account

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini .
  2. At the left, tap Menu  your Profile pic or Initial Settings Contact info from your devices.
  3. Turn on Save contact info from your signed-in devices.

Learn how to manage contact info from your devices.

Go to setting

Manage Android app permissions

Important: To use the Phone app in the Gemini mobile app, you need to allow the Google app access to your Phone.

  1. Touch and hold the Google app .
  2. Tap App info Permissions.

  • Call Logs to help Gemini connect you to the right person
  • Contacts to call device contacts that aren’t synced to your Google Account

Check or change your default phone app

Important: Some steps may vary by device and Android version.

  1. On your Android device, open Settings [Image: Settings app].
  2. Tap Apps Default apps or Choose default apps.

Take action when your phone is locked

To control whether Gemini can help you with answers to general questions when your device is locked:

Allow calls and text messages without unlocking your phone

You can ask Gemini to make calls and send text messages without unlocking your phone.

What Gemini can’t do with the Phone app

There are some actions that are available with Google Assistant that currently aren’t available with the Phone app. For now, the Phone app can’t help you accept or reject calls.

While some actions aren’t supported by the Phone app in Gemini yet, your Gemini mobile app may still perform them with help from Google Assistant, even when apps aren’t connected. Learn more about Google Assistant features in your Gemini mobile app.

Manage files & folders in your Dropbox in Gemini Apps

Manage files & folders in your Dropbox in Gemini Apps

When you connect Dropbox to Gemini Apps, you can ask Gemini to find, summarize, share, and manage your files and folders.

What you need

To connect your Dropbox to Gemini Apps, you need to:

  • Be 18 or over and in the US.
  • Be signed in to Gemini Apps with a personal Google Account. For now, this feature isn’t available if you sign in with a work or school Google Account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Have Keep Activity on. Gemini can’t connect to Dropbox when this setting is off.

Important: For now, the Dropbox connected app is:

  • Only available in English.
  • Only available in the Gemini web app at gemini.google.com.

Connect Dropbox to Gemini Apps

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Ask Gemini to perform an action in Dropbox, like find files for a specific project.
    • Tip: Mention “Dropbox” or add 0 to your prompt.
  3. If Dropbox isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to grant permission.

Tip: You can connect or disconnect the Dropbox app anytime in your Connected Apps settings.

Manage your files & folders

Important: You must confirm sensitive actions including requests to:

  • Delete, share, or change permissions for files and folders.
  • Perform bulk actions across content.

Gemini can perform a variety of actions with your Dropbox files and folders:

  • Find & summarize: Find specific files and folders, and summarize and get info from your documents.
  • Create and manage files & folders: Create, rename, copy, move, and delete files and folders in your cloud storage.
  • Get file revisions & restore files: Get a file’s revision history, and restore a specific version.
Example prompts
  • Find the latest design mockup in my ‘Project Summer’ folder on Dropbox and summarize its contents.
  • List all of my active shared links on Dropbox for the file ‘Q3 Financials.xlsx’.
  • Show me the revision history for my Q4 business proposal. I want to restore the version from last Tuesday.
  • Move all files inside my ‘Receipts’ folder to ‘Finance 2026’ and rename ‘contract_draft.docx’ to ‘Contract_Final_v1.docx’.

Manage your Business Profile on Google with the Gemini web app

Manage your Business Profile on Google with the Gemini web app

You can now quickly manage your Business Profile on Google conversationally and access your business insights in the Gemini web app. When you connect Google Business Profile with Gemini Apps, Gemini can help you:

  • Update your Business Profile, such as your business hours, contact info, and action links.
  • Engage with customers by drafting replies to reviews and creating posts.
  • Analyze and summarize customer feedback from reviews, including synthesizing feedback themes.
  • Access your business insights, including performance metrics and search keywords.

Important: Google Business Profile and business notebooks in Gemini are being released gradually and may not be available to you just yet.

How to Manage Your Google Business Profile With Gemini

What you need

To connect Google Business Profile to Gemini Apps, you must:

  • Be an owner or manager of only one verified Business Profile on Google. Learn how to verify your business on Google and manage Business Profile roles.
  • Be 18 or over.
  • Be signed in to the Gemini web app with a personal Google Account that’s associated with your Google Business Profile. For now, this feature isn’t available if you sign in with a work or school Google Account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Have Keep Activity on. Gemini can’t connect to Google Business Profile when this setting is off.

Important: For now, Google Business Profile and business notebooks in Gemini are:

  • Available wherever the Gemini web app is supported except the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom.
  • Only available in Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, and Turkish.
  • Not available to owners or managers who have access to more than one verified Business Profile.
  • Only available in the Gemini web app at gemini.google.com.

Connect Google Business Profile to Gemini Apps

When you connect Google Business Profile to Gemini Apps, you can ask Gemini questions about your Business Profile or ask it to perform actions for you, like updating your business hours.

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Make sure you’re signed in to the same account you use to access your Business Profile on Google.
  3. Ask Gemini for information about your Business Profile on Google.
    • Tip: If Gemini doesn’t use the Google Business Profile app, add 0 to your prompt.
  4. If Google Business Profile isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  5. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tip: You can connect and disconnect the Google Business Profile app at any time in your Connected Apps Settings.

Create your business notebook

You can create a business notebook to unlock proactive insights and tailored prompts that help you manage and grow your business with Gemini.

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Make sure you’re signed in to the same account you use to access your Business Profile on Google.
  3. If you’re eligible, you’ll get an option to create your business notebook. Select Connect.
    • Google Business Profile must be connected to Gemini Apps to create your business notebook. If it’s not, you’ll get the option to connect it.
    • Tip: If the option to create your business notebook isn’t there, try adding 0 to a prompt to have Gemini offer to create it.
  4. Enter or confirm the website URL for your business.

Check your business notebook

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. On the sidebar under “Notebooks,” click your business notebook. It has the same name as your business in Google Business Profile.
    • If the sidebar is closed, hover over Gemini and click Open sidebar .

What’s in your business notebook

Your business notebook includes additional features, like:

  • Proactive insights about your business, including suggested actions like:
    • Updating missing Business Profile info, like business hours or a description.
    • Adding photos, like an exterior photo of your business.
    • Reviewing your Business Profile’s performance.
  • Suggested prompts to explore ways Gemini can help you with your business.
  • Recent chats in your business notebook.

Learn more about notebooks in Gemini Apps.

Update your Business Profile

You can ask Gemini to update your business information to keep your customers informed. Gemini can help you manage:

  • Business hours: Modify regular weekly schedules or set special hours for holidays and events.
  • Food menus: For food-related businesses, create, update, or delete menus, including sections, dish names, descriptions, and prices.
  • Media: Upload new photos using a public URL, or get media that you or customers uploaded.
  • Business attributes: Review and modify details like “Outdoor Seating,” “Happy Hour,” or “Wi-Fi.” These options vary by business category.
  • Contact information: Review and modify your website URL or social media links.
  • Action links: Manage links for online ordering, reservations, or appointments.
  • Location details: Get and review the internal technical data and the status of your profile.

Example prompts

  • Show all the contact information on my profile
  • Show all the links on my profile
  • Review all my business attributes
  • Show my current location details
  • Update my business description

Engage with customers

You can ask Gemini to help you manage customer reviews and posts for your business. Gemini can help you with:

  • Customer reviews: Get star ratings and customer reviews, including associated media.
  • Review replies: Draft or delete replies to customer feedback.
  • Profile posts: Create, schedule, publish, or delete Update, Offer, or Event posts.

Example prompts

  • Show me my recent customer reviews
  • Summarize my recent reviews
  • Help me draft a reply to my latest review
  • Help me brainstorm and create a new post

Access your business insights

You can access your Business Profile insights in Gemini to conveniently understand performance metrics and improve your visibility. Gemini can help you with:

  • Performance metrics: Analyze impressions, website clicks, direction requests, and bookings.
  • Search keywords: Review the specific keywords customers use to find your business.

Example prompts

  • Show me my performance metrics for the past month
  • What are the top search keywords driving traffic to my business

Manage your universal cart

Manage your universal cart

Important: This feature is currently available only in the United States.

Universal cart allows you to save products across Google services and manage them in one central location so it can travel with you while you shop.

You can discover and add products to your cart from the following surfaces:

  • Google Search & Shopping
  • AI Mode
  • Gemini Apps

Manage items and cart checkout

Inside your cart, products are organized by merchants. Here you can review product details, or remove items.

When you are ready to buy, there are two ways to check out:

  • Check out with Google Pay: For participating merchants, you can complete your transaction on Google using your saved payment methods.
  • Check out on the merchant site: For other merchants, Google helps you populate your cart on the merchant’s website so you can complete the purchase there.

Track your orders

After purchasing, merchants may share information about your order with Google. For those orders, you can monitor your progress in the “My Orders” tab located within the cart.

  • Status updates: Get fulfillment details like “shipped” or “delivered” for supported merchants.
  • History: Find a list of your applicable recent purchases made through your cart.

Manage your data

Your cart and order are saved in Google Wallet. For more details on how to control your data, visit Manage data & privacy in Google Wallet (US only).

Understand limitations in Gemini Apps and AI Mode

You can save items to your cart through Gemini Apps and AI Mode. These surfaces have limited access to your data and may be unable to complete the following.

  • List your cart items or status updates directly in a chat conversation.
  • Add items directly into your cart.
  • Provide updates about your order.

Commonly asked questions

I cannot see my order data

Merchants may provide Google with the order data for the items in your cart that you purchase with the merchant. Some merchants do not share data back to Google so these orders do not appear in the “My orders” tab.

There’s a problem with my purchase

To fix these issues, contact the merchant you made the purchase from.

  • Play music that I like
  • Play rock music radio
  • Show me songs from modern artists keeping classic blues alive

You can also use these prompts:

  • Find [song name] by [artist name]
  • Find the album [album title] by [artist name]
  • Find [playlist name] playlist on YouTube Music
  • Find [genre] music on YouTube Music
  • Search for songs similar to [song name] by [artist name] on YouTube Music
  • Find the song that goes [song lyrics]
  • Find the [song name] music video on YouTube Music
  • Start a radio based on the song [song name]
  • Search for [artist name] songs on YouTube Music

Create a radio or playlist in YouTube Music

Important: For now, you can create a radio or playlist with English prompts only.

With Youtube Music, you can set up a radio for a continuous stream of songs based on your preferences or a playlist for a fixed set of tracks.

You can ask Gemini Apps to create a YouTube Music radio or playlist.

To create a radio, try these examples:

  • Create a radio of songs I’m familiar with
  • Play [time period and genre] songs that are less well known
  • Create a [mood] radio for [activity]
  • Play [mood] music to start my [day, week]
  • Play upbeat songs by [artist name] or [artist name]
  • Play the [artist name] radio on YouTube Music

To create a playlist, try these examples:

  • Make a playlist with [genre, mood, activity] music
  • Build a [artist name] playlist with [mood] music
  • Mix up a [genre] playlist that’s best for [mood, activity]
  • Create a [mood, activity, season] playlist [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Add [genre, artist name] music to it

Tip: To save the playlist or radio to your library, select Save to library.

About your YouTube Music watch history

When you use the YouTube Music app in Gemini, your YouTube Music watch history is stored based on your settings. You can view and manage your YouTube Music watch history. Learn how to manage your watch history.

Play & search for music from Spotify with the Gemini mobile app

Play & search for music from Spotify with the Gemini mobile app

When you link your Spotify account to your Google Account, you can ask the Gemini mobile app to play or search for music or podcasts on Spotify. For example, you can ask for music by song, album, artist, playlist, and more.

What you need

To connect Spotify to Gemini Apps on an Android phone or tablet, you need to:

  • Use the Gemini mobile app, including as your mobile assistant. Learn more about the Gemini mobile app.
  • Be signed in to the Gemini mobile app. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Have Keep Activity on. Gemini can’t connect to Spotify when this setting is off.

Important:

  • For now, Spotify isn’t available in Gemini in Google Messages, the Gemini web app, or Live chats.
  • Spotify plays the specific song or podcast you requested only if you have a Spotify Premium subscription.
  • You can also say ‘Hey Google’ to ask Gemini to use a connected app. If “Hey Google” doesn’t work, check if “Hey Google” and Voice Match are set up.

Connect Spotify to Gemini Apps

To connect to Spotify, your Spotify account must be linked to your Google Account. You might have already linked it through another Google service. If not, follow the steps below to connect Spotify to your Google Account through the Gemini mobile app.

  1. Ask the Gemini app to play, search, or browse media on Spotify.
  2. If Spotify isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tips:

  • You can connect and disconnect the Spotify app anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.
  • For steps to unlink your Spotify account from all Google services, learn how to manage third-party connections.

Play or search for media on Spotify

Important: If you connected more than one media app and don’t specify one in your request, Gemini uses the last media app you used. To use another one that’s available, you can mention the media service or “@” mention it in your prompt.

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to find and play music or podcasts on Spotify. Try the example prompts below.

Play music
  • Play [album name] on Spotify
  • Play [song name] by [artist name] on Spotify
  • Play my Spotify playlist called [playlist name]
  • Play music for [activity] on Spotify
Search for music
  • Search for [artist name] songs
  • Search for the song that goes [lyrics]
  • Find a Spotify playlist with [genre, mood, activity] music
Search for & play podcasts
  • Play [podcast name] on Spotify
  • Play the latest episode of [podcast name] on Spotify
  • Find me a podcast about [topic] on Spotify.

What Gemini Apps can’t do with Spotify

Gemini Apps can’t perform certain actions in Spotify for you, like:

  • Create a Spotify playlist or radio
  • Control media playback with commands like pause, resume, next, and previous
    • On Android phones and tablets, the Gemini mobile app can control media playback with the Utilities apps. Learn more about the Utilities app.

How your data is handled

Search for flights & hotels in Gemini Apps

Search for flights & hotels in Gemini Apps

You can ask Gemini Apps to help you plan your next trip or vacation. Gemini uses public information from Google Flights and Google Hotels to help you:

  • Pull in real-time flight info for intuitive travel planning
  • Search hotels based on the details you provide
  • And more

What you need

  • Be signed in to the Gemini app. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Keep Activity on. This feature isn’t available when this setting is off.

Important:

  • For now, this feature isn’t available in Live chats.
  • This feature isn’t available in Gemini in Google Messages.

Search for flights & hotels

Ask via gemini.google.com

You can ask Gemini to find flight and hotel info.

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Ask Gemini to find info on flights and hotels for your next trip.

Ask via Gemini in Chrome

  1. On your computer, open Chrome.
  2. At the top right of your browser, click Ask Gemini .
  3. In the Gemini dialog box, ask for info on flights and hotels for your next trip.
    • To continue to auto browse your tabs, you should grant Gemini in Chrome permission. Learn how auto browse works.
Examples
  • Find flights to Miami for New Years. What’s the usual temperature then?
  • Find hotels for a 4-day trip to San Francisco for New Years Eve.
  • Show me flights to Tokyo and give me ideas of things to do. How about Seoul too?
  • Find hotels in Phuket for a week in March and suggest a packing list
  • Find nonstop flights from San Francisco to anywhere

Flight & hotel details you can search by

With Google Flights, Gemini can find flights based on details like:

  • Origin and destination cities
  • Departure and arrival dates
  • Airline
  • Maximum price
  • Maximum number of stops
  • Number of passengers
  • Minimum or maximum length of trip
  • Seating class
  • One way or round trip

With Google Hotels, Gemini can search for hotels based on details like:

  • Location
  • Booking dates
  • Number of nights
  • Number of adults
  • Currency
  • Amenities
  • Hotel brand or description

What Gemini Apps can’t do

The following actions aren’t supported in Gemini Apps when it connects to Google Flights or Google Hotels:

  • Book a flight or hotel for you
  • Cancel or update existing reservations
  • Check you in for a flight or into a hotel
  • Get alerts on saved flights
  • Search for flights by airline alliance
  • Find package deals not available through Google Hotels

About your data & other Google services

Learn more about how your data is used and how Gemini Apps get help from Google services in the Gemini Apps Privacy Notice.

Search for your photos, videos & more with Gemini Apps

Search for your photos, videos & more with Gemini Apps

You can search for specific photos, videos, memories, and more from your gallery apps, like Google Photos or Samsung Gallery, in Gemini Apps.

Important: You can still upload photos to your prompts, even if your gallery app isn’t connected. Learn how to upload photos in Gemini Apps.

Tip: You can also get personalized Gemini experiences based on your data from Google Photos when you connect the Google Photos app. Learn more about personalization based on Connected Apps.

What you need

To connect gallery apps to Gemini Apps, you need to:

  • Sign in to the Gemini app with a personal Google Account. The supported gallery apps aren’t available if you sign in to a work, school, or supervised Google Account. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps.
  • Have Keep Activity on. Gemini can’t connect to gallery apps when this setting is off.

Important: Gallery apps aren’t available in Gemini in Google Messages or in Live chats.

Additional requirements to connect Google Photos

Additionally, to connect Google Photos to Gemini Apps, you need to:

  • Be 18 or over.
  • Be in a supported country or territory. This feature isn’t available in some United States regions.
  • Have these Google Photos settings turned on:
    • Face Groups and select which face is yours. Learn how to turn on Face Groups and how to select your face group.
    • Estimate missing locations. Learn how to turn on Estimate missing locations.

Countries & territories where you can connect Google Photos

You can currently connect Google Photos to Gemini Apps in the following countries and territories only:

  • Algeria - Angola - Argentina - Australia - Bahrain - Bangladesh - Barbados - Belize - Benin - Bermuda - Bhutan - Bolivia - Botswana - Brazil - Burkina Faso - Burundi - Cabo Verde - Cameroon - Cayman Islands - Central African Republic - Chad - Chile - Colombia - Costa Rica - Djibouti - Dominican Republic - Ecuador - Egypt - El Salvador - Equatorial Guinea - Eritrea - Ethiopia - Fiji - Gabon - Ghana - Grenada - Guatemala - Guinea - Guyana - Haiti - Honduras - India - Indonesia - Iraq - Jamaica - Japan - Jordan - Kenya - Kuwait - Kyrgyzstan - Lebanon - Lesotho - Liberia, - Libya - Madagascar - Malawi - Maldives - Mali - Mauritania - Mauritius - Mexico - Morocco - Mozambique - Nepal - New Zealand - Nicaragua - Niger - Oman - Pakistan - Palestine - Panama - Papua New Guinea - Paraguay - Peru - Philippines - Qatar - Rwanda - Samoa - Saudi Arabia - Senegal - Sierra Leone - Singapore - Somalia - South Africa - Sri Lanka - Tajikistan - The Bahamas - The Gambia - Togo - Tonga - Trinidad and Tobago - Tunisia - Turkmenistan - Tuvalu - Uganda - United Arab Emirates - United States (except some regions) - United States Minor Outlying Islands - Uruguay - Venezuela - Vietnam - Yemen - Zambia - Zimbabwe

Connect Google Photos to Gemini Apps

  1. On your computer, go to gemini.google.com.
  2. Make sure you’re signed in to the same account you use with Google Photos.
  3. Ask the Gemini app to find a photo in your Google Photos library.
    • Tip: Include 0 or 1 in your prompt to make sure it uses the Google Photos app.
  4. If Google Photos isn’t connected and you’re eligible, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  5. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tip: You can disconnect Google Photos from Gemini Apps anytime in your Connected Apps settings.

Ask for your photos & videos or about them

You can ask Gemini to find photos and videos from your connected gallery apps. When you do this, the search results are provided directly by your gallery app, not Gemini.

Find photos, videos & albums

You can find photos, videos, and albums based on:

  • Your face groups or relationships you’ve saved in Photos
  • Location or date the photo or video was taken
  • Description of what’s in the photo or video
  • Your current chat with Gemini

Example prompts:

  • Find my photos of Alex
  • Show my photos from last summer
  • Show me recent selfies
  • Show my photos from my most recent trip
  • Find my photos of landscapes

Find info in photos & videos from Google Photos

You can ask for important details found in your photos and videos such as:

  • @Google Photos what themes have we had for Lena’s birthday parties?
  • @Google Photos what did we eat at the hotel in Stanly?
  • @Google Photos what were some of the things we ate in Mexico City?
  • @Google Photos what are the top 10 things we saw on our last trip?
  • @Google Photos what’s my driver’s license number?

Do more with your photos & videos

  • Click a photo to open a larger version of it in Google Photos.
  • Click a video to open and play it in Google Photos.
  • Click an album to open it in Google Photos.

Important: If Gemini’s response includes photos or videos retrieved from Google Photos, the share or export features only work with the text portion of the response and photos and videos aren’t included.

What Gemini Apps can’t do

  • Use the editing features within the gallery apps.
  • Add labels, like names or locations, to your photos in your gallery apps.
  • Create new albums or edit existing ones in your gallery apps.

Send messages with the Gemini mobile app on Android

Send messages with the Gemini mobile app on Android

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to send text messages with images for you with the Messages app, which uses your phone’s default messaging app. You can also ask it to help compose and edit messages.

To help you quickly get started, the Messages app will work automatically on your device depending on your device app permissions and other settings. If you upgraded to Gemini from Google Assistant and your Personal Results setting was turned off, you may need to connect the Messages app in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

What you need

  • An Android phone or tablet.
  • An active mobile phone plan.
  • The Gemini app, including as your mobile assistant. Learn more about the Gemini mobile app.
    • The Messages app is not supported in Gemini in Google Messages or the Gemini web app.
  • Save contact info from your signed-in devices on.
    • With the Messages app, Gemini can help you send messages to contacts saved to your Google Account. Learn how to sync your device contacts to your Google Account.
  • The SMS Android app permission given to the Google app.
    • Learn how to manage Android app permissions.

Important:

  • For now, this feature isn’t available in Live chats.
  • Connected Apps are not available while using features powered directly by Google Assistant.
  • Messages that you create with the Gemini app are not end-to-end encrypted.
  • You can use Gemini to send messages even when Keep Activity is off. If Keep Activity is off, a message request that requires certain other apps or Google services may not work. For example, asking Gemini to “text the nearest pizza place” would require Google Maps, which isn’t available if Keep Activity is off.
    • On a connected smart watch, you can only use Gemini to send messages when Keep Activity is on.

Connect the Messages app in Gemini

Important: The Messages app in Gemini is designed to work automatically with the Gemini mobile app. You can disconnect the Messages app anytime in your Connected Apps settings. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini .
  2. Ask it to send a message to one of your contacts.
    • If Gemini doesn’t use the Messages app, add 0 to your prompt. If the app isn’t connected, you’ll get the option to connect it.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Tip: You can also say ‘Hey Google’ to ask Gemini to use a connected app. If ‘Hey Google’ doesn’t work, check if ‘Hey Google’ and Voice Match are set up.

Example
  • Help me write a congratulations message to [contact name] on their 25th anniversary. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Actually, make it a haiku. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Send it to [contact name].

Send a message

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to send a message in any way that feels natural and conversational to you.

Try these example prompts:

  • Send a message to [contact name].
  • Text [contact name] [message].
  • Ask [contact name] [question].

Tip: By default, the Gemini mobile app uses the last app it used to message the same contact. If the Gemini app uses the Messages app, it uses your default SMS app on your Android device. Learn how to change your default SMS app.

Add an image to your message

Important:

  • For now, this feature only works if Google Messages is set as your default messaging app.
  • If you’re outside the US, you need RCS chats turned on. Learn how to turn on RCS chats.
  • The Gemini mobile app can’t add images when you reply to a notification.

You can ask the Gemini mobile app to send an image to a contact, either by itself or with a message. You can generate a new image, search for one on the web, or upload your own. For now, only static images in GIF, JPEG, or PNG format are supported.

Try these example prompts:

  • Generate a coloring book image of a knight fighting a giant cat. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Send it to my wife and ask her to print it.
  • Find a picture of the Eiffel tower. [Image: After Gemini’s response:] Send it to mom saying I’m so excited about our trip to Paris!
  • Send this to [contact name].

Manage settings

Important: Even if you disconnect the Messages app, the Gemini mobile app can still access:

  • Your device contacts if the Google app has Contacts permission. Learn how to manage Android app permissions.
  • Your notifications if the Utilities app is connected. Learn how to manage Connected Apps in Gemini.

Sync your device contacts to your Google Account

  1. On your Android phone or tablet, open Gemini .
  2. At the left, tap Menu  your Profile pic or Initial Settings Contact info from your devices.
  3. Turn on Save contact info from your signed-in devices.

Learn how to manage contact info from your devices.

Go to setting

Manage Android app permissions

Important: To use the Messages app in the Gemini mobile app, you need to allow the Google app access to your SMS.

  1. Touch and hold the Google app .
  2. Tap App info Permissions.
  3. To change a permission setting, tap it, then choose Allow or Don’t allow.

Tip: For a better experience, you can also choose to allow access to your Contacts to message device contacts that aren’t synced to your Google Account

Check or change your default SMS app

Important: Some steps may vary by device and Android version.

  1. On your Android device, open Settings [Image: Settings app].
  2. Tap Apps Default apps or Choose default apps.
  3. Tap SMS app.
  4. To change the default app, select the SMS app you want to use.

What Gemini can’t do with the Messages app

The following actions aren’t supported by the Messages app in Gemini:

  • Read or summarize your messages directly from your messaging app.
  • Create or message group chats.
  • Read images or memes in your messages.
  • Add or play audio or videos in your messages.
  • Read or respond to messages in your device notifications.
    • Gemini only uses the Utilities app to read or reply to messages in your notifications, including those from WhatsApp. Learn more about the Utilities app.

About your data & communication apps

The Gemini mobile app uses your data to help it choose the most helpful app to use and connect you with the right person. Learn more about your data and communication apps.

How your data is handled

Learn more about how your data is handled when Gemini works with Connected Apps.

Use Gemini Apps with a work or school Google Account

Use apps connected to Gemini with a work or school Google Account

Use apps connected to Gemini with a work or school Google Account

Gemini Apps can interact with other services called Connected Apps to provide more helpful responses to your prompts. For example, Gemini can help you:

  • Find information from Gmail or summarize documents from Drive
  • Find and summarize information from Google Chat
  • Add and show your tasks from Google Tasks
  • Create and show your notes and lists in Google Keep
  • Create, find, and edit your events in Google Calendar
  • Get quick answers and stay organized in Google Classroom
  • Attach a GitHub repository to better understand the codebase and debug issues

Important: If you’re using Gemini Apps with a personal account, learn how to use Connected Apps in Gemini.

What you need

When using a work or school Google Account, you can connect apps to Gemini if:

  • You have a qualifying edition of Google Workspace.
  • Your Keep Activity setting is turned on. Only your account’s Google Workspace administrator can manage these settings. Learn more about Gemini Apps Activity settings for work or school accounts.
  • Your account’s Google Workspace administrator has enabled the ability to connect apps to Gemini. If you’re a Google Workspace administrator, learn how to manage access to apps in Gemini.

How to use apps in Gemini

Important: Gemini Apps can hallucinate responses or provide outdated information, like from an older email when there’s a more recent one. To check the information, click and review the sources listed after the response.

  1. Go to gemini.google.com.
    • If you’re connecting to a Google Workspace app, make sure you’re signed in to the same account you use with Google Workspace.
  2. In the text box at the bottom, enter 0 and select the app you want to use.
    • Tip: Enter 0 and select Google Drive. In your prompt, reference content in Google Workspace using keywords from the content.
  3. Ask Gemini Apps to get information from the other app or service.
  4. Click Submit . If the app has been enabled by your Workspace administrator, Gemini Apps automatically use it.

Examples

  • Find information
    • What dates did Erik propose in the email about the team offsite?
  • Summarize a document
    • Find notes from the latest team meeting titled “Team Meeting June 2023” from my drive and summarize it to a short paragraph
  • Simplify and organize information
    • Find the doc from Ashley about the website clean-up project and summarize the proposal for me in 5 bullets

Learn more about Connected Apps

Important: Availability of Connected Apps vary by account type, Google Workspace edition, location, language, device, and Gemini app. For details, review the articles below.

Learn about the tools and services that Gemini Apps can interact with when you’re signed in to a work or school account:

  • You can ask Gemini Apps to interact with a number of apps and services, including:
    • The Google Workspace connected app, which includes these services:
      • Gmail
      • Google Calendar
      • Google Chat (currently available in English if you have Gemini Apps as a core service)
      • Google Docs
      • Google Drive
      • Google Keep
      • Google Tasks
    • The Google Classroom connected app, which is currently available in English only. Your admin must designate you as 18 or over to use this app.
  • In the Gemini web app on a computer, you can also import a GitHub repository to your chat and ask Gemini about its code with the GitHub app.

Why can’t I use an app

Mention the app you want to use in your prompt

For example, enter 0, select Google Drive, and use keywords from the content you want Gemini to reference in your prompt. For every new conversation, you need to explicitly ask the Gemini app to get something from the other app or service explicitly. You don’t need to do this for follow up questions.

One or more apps may not be enabled by your organization

For users with a work or school Google Account, access to apps must be enabled by your Workspace administrator.

If your prompt includes multiple actions that require separate  apps or services, but one or more of the required services are not enabled, neither of the actions will be completed. For example, if you prompt Gemini to create an event on your calendar and a reminder for that event, and the Tasks app is not enabled, the event will not be added to your calendar and  you will not get a reminder.

If you’re a Google Workspace administrator, learn how to manage access to apps in Gemini.

What Gemini can’t do with Connected Apps

Important: Your Google Workspace administrator can enable or disable access to apps. If you can’t access a certain app in Gemini, reach out to your administrator.

There are certain actions that Gemini Apps can’t do using Connected Apps. But some of them are possible using other features in Gemini Apps. Review the list of unsupported actions below.

Gmail

Gemini Apps cannot:

  • Access comments or images in Gmail.
  • Create an email draft or delete emails in Gmail.
    • Tip: To use a response as an email draft, learn how to export a response to Google Workspace.
  • Count items in your Gmail or tell you how much Gmail storage you have.

Google Classroom

Gemini Apps cannot:

  • Enter grades or provide private feedback directly in Google Classroom.
  • Delete, archive, or post assignments or announcements in Google Classroom.
  • Create rubrics in Google Classroom.

Google Drive

Gemini Apps cannot:

  • Access pictures and videos in your Drive.
    • This includes any content that isn’t in a document, spreadsheet, presentation, or PDF.
    • Tip: To access multiple docs in a prompt, mention all of the desired files in the prompt.
  • Manage content in your Drive, like create folders or move content between folders.
  • Count items in your Drive or tell you how much Drive storage you have.

Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

Gemini Apps cannot:

  • Access comments or images in Docs.
  • Create, draft, or delete spreadsheets, PDFs, documents, and presentations.
    • Tip: To use a response as a Docs draft, learn how to export a response to Google Workspace.

What happens if access to apps in Gemini is disabled

Important: If you’re using Gemini with a work or school account, apps can only be enabled or disabled by the account’s Google Workspace administrator.

If apps are disabled after you have started a chat using an app, you will still be able to view and continue the chat. Gemini Apps will only have continued access to the information that was needed to respond to the original prompt. Gemini Apps won’t be able to access any additional information from the other app or service unless apps are enabled again in Gemini.
